people.imagined: In the array chamber at night he has set down a square against a stone plate and is checking an edge with his thumb. Twice measured. The grey dust in the creases of his hands is the same grey as his robe.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a flat stone plate in a lamplit chamber, he holds a steel carpenter's square against its edge and glances up calmly at the viewer. Face: a long, patient, grey-dusted face; deep creases that hold fine grey stone dust; steady pale-brown eyes; thick grey brows; a long straight nose; a firm, closed mouth; a short grey beard. Hair: iron-grey, in a plain knot pinned with a dark iron pin. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, a little stooped, big square hands. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, pressed and clean but dusted at the cuffs; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star pinned at the collar. Hands and objects (the grey dust must read): both hands are visibly grey with stone dust, ground into every crease; a steel carpenter's square tucked in the belt and a second small square flag on a staff leaning behind him, the flag a plain grey cloth; a flat stone plate scored with faint line patterns (no writing). Background: blurred dark chamber, rows of small standing stones. Light: warm low lamplight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint at the stone. Expression: diligent, stubborn, calm; a man who measures twice.

people.imagined: At the open scales in the weigh-house she balances a coin on her fingertip as she talks, feeling its weight, and does not look at the speaker but at the coin. The black touchstone at her throat swings.
people.subject: The moment: balanced between finger and thumb she holds a silver coin up before her eyes, studying its weight, while her eyes flick across to the viewer. Face: a neat, colourless, narrow face; pale skin; flat, very light grey eyes; thin precise brows; a thin straight nose; a thin, level mouth that gives nothing away. A faint line of concentration sits between her brows and her lips are bloodless. Hair: dark brown, drawn into a very tight flat knot with a plain iron pin. Body: slim, upright, exact, shoulders level as a beam. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, perfectly pressed, narrow sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. At her throat, on a thin cord, a black jasper pendant scored with thousands of fine gold and silver streaks, plainly visible. Hands and objects: the coin between finger and thumb of the right hand; a small brass balance with two pans on the table before her, one pan holding a single grey pebble. Her fingertips are dry and fine, and the nails are cut straight across. Background: blurred weigh-house shelves of brass weights in rows. Light: bright white light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint at the coin. Expression: a flat, precise, level attention, the pale eyes sliding from the coin to the viewer, a diligent woman who weighs people the way she weighs silver and trusts neither; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint at the coin.

people.imagined: On the snow ridge above Tinh Tủy Mạch at noon, narrowing his pale eyes against the glare off the stone, he is listening for a watch order that has never been read to him.
people.subject: The moment: on a bright snowfield he stands with his eyes narrowed to slits against the glare, looking out past the viewer, one gloved hand shading his brow. Face (most important: the snow-burnt face and narrow pale eyes): a lean, hard face with skin burnt red-brown and peeling, cracked lips; very pale grey eyes squeezed to thin slits with deep crow's-feet; short white eyebrows; a hawkish nose; a short white stubble. Snow-glare has bleached the lashes and flakes of dead skin curl at his nose. Hair: white, cropped close, a fur-lined hood pushed back. Body: tall, lean, hard-framed, upright. Clothing: a fur-lined heavy coat of undyed grey wool over dark-grey lamellar armour with a crossed collar, a seven-knot black cord at the waist and a small silver star at the collar; leather gloves. Hands and objects: one gloved hand raised to shade the brow; the other on the shaft of a long spear planted in the snow beside him. Background: a blinding white snow slope and a blue-white vein of snow-jade stone, blurred. A wind-scoured crest runs along the top of the frame and a thin plume of spindrift blows off it. Light: harsh white glare from above and left. Expression: a loyal, reclusive, patient squint into the glare, the cracked lips closed, a sentry still listening for an order that was never read to him.

people.imagined: On the Bridge Court bench, smiling at an advocate as he turns his jade ring slowly, listening to a toll case. He has already decided and enjoys the listening.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a judge's bench he smiles benignly at the viewer while turning a jade ring on his finger with the other thumb. Face: a plump, smooth, rosy, smiling face; small bright dark eyes in folds of fat; thin arched brows; a round nose; a soft, full mouth in an easy, charming smile; a double chin. A little pink sheen of well-fed health lies on his cheeks. Hair: black, oiled, in a neat topknot with a jade pin. Body: round, comfortable, soft-shouldered, leaning back. Clothing: a bench robe of FINER grey silk than the usual cloth, lustrous with a faint sheen, crossed collar edged in a thin darker grey band, wide sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a thick green jade ring on the left hand being turned; the right hand resting on a smooth wooden gavel-block; a small balance of brass on the bench beside him. Background: blurred dim court hall with stone pillars. A banner of plain grey cloth hangs between two pillars and the shapes of advocates stand small in the hall. Light: warm light from the upper left; a gleam on the ring; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a benign, comfortable, charming smile with the small eyes bright and unhurried, a man who has already decided the case and enjoys the listening.

people.imagined: At the writ office desk, ink on her right hand and her falconer's leather guard still on the left wrist, she looks up from a ledger with a glint, as if sighting a hare.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk with a brush in her right hand she looks up sharply with a hunter's alert, glittering stare. Face: a lean, weathered, hard-boned face; sharp amber eyes, the pupils small; strong straight brows; a thin nose; a thin mouth with a faint curl of a deceitful smile; a short pale scar on the chin. Fine sun-lines fan at her eyes from years of watching a far sky. Hair: black with grey, in a tight low knot with an iron pin. Body: lean, straight, wiry; a ropy forearm. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, cuffs inked; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the leather guard must read): on the left wrist a thick brown LEATHER falconer's guard, worn and clearly visible, with a tied-on cord; the right hand, black with ink, holds the brush; a thick bound ledger with a plain cover open before her. A single grey feather lies on the desk beside the ink dish. Background: blurred writ office, shelves of rolled documents. Light: cool light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a sharp, glittering, hunter's attention with a faint curl at the lip, a woman sighting something in the ledger as she would a hare; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint.

people.imagined: At dusk on the barrow, leaning on her lamp-pole as the miasma-pale air moves, she coughs into her hand and does not apologise, then raises the lamp.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a thin pale haze she leans on a long pole with a small lamp at its tip and coughs into her fist, without apology, looking steadily at the viewer. Face (most important: the grey skin): a gaunt, frail, ashen face with grey skin the colour of old ash; sunken dark eyes with violet shadows; thin grey brows; a sharp nose; thin colourless lips; hollow cheeks. Hair: white, long and thin, in a low braid wound round the head. Body: very thin, slightly bent, frail wrists, but planted. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, immaculate, with a crossed collar and a heavy grey wool shawl; a seven-knot black cord at the waist; a small silver star at the collar; at the throat a dried knot of pale root bound in jade wire. Hands and objects: a tall lamp-pole of dark wood with a small yellow flame in a glass at the top, in both hands; a faded breath-mist on the air. Background: blurred pale miasma fog over a dark plain, a distant grave mound. Light: dim yellow lamplight from the upper left and a cold grey fog; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: devout, stubborn, content; death is a familiar.

people.imagined: At the harbour tavern with a wine cup in his scarred arm, laughing at a story told by himself, his voice filling the room. He wants a ship's bell with his name on it and one more winter.
people.subject: The moment: at a tavern table he roars with laughter with his head back and a wine cup raised in his left hand. Face: a huge, red, soft face gone slack with drink; small bright blue eyes squeezed in folds; bushy white brows; a big nose veined red; a wide open mouth with several teeth missing; a thick white moustache. Tears of laughter shine in the creases beside his eyes. Hair: white, long and thin, tied back with a sea-blue cord. Body: a barrel-shaped man, once a fighter, gone soft; huge belly; thick neck. His heavy shoulders shake with the laugh and a thick hand rests flat on the table. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe of loose, rumpled cut, crossed collar open at the throat, a seven-knot black cord at the waist cinching his belly; a small silver star at the collar; the left sleeve rolled to show a long, glossy burn scar from wrist to elbow, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a heavy wine cup of grey pottery in the raised hand; a ship's bell, a small iron one, on the table before him. Background: blurred tavern, lanterns, harbour masts through a window. Brass lamps swing on chains and the black masts of the harbour show through the window. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left; a faint blue water qi hint. Expression: a huge, loose, red-faced roar of laughter, eyes squeezed to wet slits, the booming good cheer of a loud old man who wants one more winter and a bell with his name on it.

people.imagined: Under the open sky of a courtyard outside the seat's walls, he has a seven-string zither on his knees and has stopped himself before the first note, one hand over the strings. His fingers are tucked in his sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: seated cross-legged beneath an open sky with a seven-string zither on his knees, he presses his long fingers lightly over the strings without plucking, with a mild, wistful smile. Face: a mild, round, pleasant face; soft brown eyes; thin gentle brows; a small nose; a kind, round-chinned mouth; a faint stubble. Faint laugh lines and a hint of a second chin soften his jaw. Hair: black with grey, in a loose knot pinned with an iron pin; a strand across the forehead. Body: round-shouldered, soft, slouching gently. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, wide sleeves; a seven-knot black cord at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. The robe is clean and well hung, its wide sleeves pushed back from the wrists to free the hands. Hands and objects (the calluses must read): the long fingers are visible on the strings, with thick hard yellow calluses on every fingertip, large and plain; a plain dark-wood zither with seven steel strings on his knees; pine needles scattered on the ground. Background: blurred tall pines and a wide pale sky. Dry brown needles lie scattered at his knees, and a little breeze stirs the pine boughs. Light: soft clear daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint and a green wood qi. Expression: a mild, soft, longing half-smile with the eyes lowered to the strings, the look of a gentle man holding back from the first note.

people.imagined: In a tavern corner with his back to the wall, he has just seen a woman at the far table and has gone completely still, his hand flat on the table. He wears no sect colours; the lightning-tree burns glisten on his neck.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in a corner with his back to a wall he stares fixedly across the room, perfectly still, one scarred hand flat on the table. Face (most important: the lightning-burn scars): a lean, hard, wiry face; branching, fern-like red scars of lightning burns crawling up the left side of the neck and across the cheek, clearly visible and bright pink-red against pale skin; narrow black eyes; thin black brows; a hooked nose; a thin cruel mouth. Hair: black, long and unkempt, bound at the nape with a strip of leather. Body: wiry, tense, a hunter's coiled stillness. Clothing: a plain dark charcoal travelling coat with a high collar, fine and well made, with NO sect colours, no grey and no cord; a dark leather vest; fingerless gloves. Hands and objects: the scarred hand flat on a table; beside it a short steel hunting spear leaning on the wall; sewn into the lining, a thin line of stitching along the coat's inner edge showing at the open cuff. Background: blurred dim tavern wall, a lamp. Light: low amber lamplight from the lower left; a faint ember fire qi hint with a pale flash. Expression: cruel, loyal, paranoid; very still.

people.imagined: Alone in the archive, he lifts a page to his nose and sniffs, a clerk's habit. While his master naps he is pressing her key into a wax block. He has stopped, hearing a step.
people.subject: The moment: among low shelves he stands bent at the waist holding a sheet of old paper to his nose, sniffing, eyes rolled sideways toward the viewer as if a footstep were heard. Face: a long, pale, narrow face; large, pale, watchful eyes; thin high brows; a long thin nose; a thin mouth held in a slight tension; dry, papery skin. A thin line of sweat gleams at his temple despite the cool of the archive. Hair: black going grey, thin, tied in a knot with a wooden pin. Body: very tall, stooped, thin, long arms, the stoop of a man who works under low shelves. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, slightly ink-spotted at the cuffs; a seven-knot black cord at the waist; a thin cord of brass keys at his neck, empty of a keeper's key-cord. Hands and objects: a sheet of yellowed paper, with only faint stains and no writing, held to his nose; in the other hand, a small block of soft wax hidden half inside his sleeve. Background: blurred tall dim shelves of scrolls in boxes. Narrow aisles run off between the shelves into shadow, and fine dust hangs gold in the lamplight. Light: low yellow lamp-light from the left, dust motes; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a thin, held, watchful tension, wide pale eyes rolled toward an unseen footstep and the mouth tight, the quiet alarm of a man caught half-way through a theft.

people.imagined: In the court clerk's office with a thick ledger open on her forearm like a tray, she pulls the lead pencil from behind her ear and begins to copy, careful that nobody sees which page.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a heavy ledger held open on her left forearm, she draws a lead pencil from behind her ear with her right hand and looks to the side with caution. Face: a plain, honest, oval face; clear light-brown eyes; level thin brows; a straight nose; a small, firm mouth; no ornament, a face built to be trusted. A faint dent from a long habit of frowning sits between her brows. Hair: black, pinned in a flat bun, a lead pencil tucked behind the right ear (clearly visible). A few grey strands show at the temples. Body: slim, middle height, upright, steady. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, well pressed and fine but unadorned; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; ink-stained cuffs. Hands and objects: a large ledger open with only rows of tidy tick marks and ruled lines (no letters) resting on her forearm; the pencil in her right hand; at her feet a ceramic rice jar with a lid. Background: blurred plain court office, a high window, shelves of boxes. A shaft of grey window light falls across the desk and picks out the dust above the boxes. Light: cool light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a plain, honest, guarded face, eyes slid to the side and lips pressed together, the quiet fear of a careful woman who is copying what she should not.

people.imagined: In the rain at the gate of the Tower, in a rain cape, counting under his breath: the men on the wall, the carts, the forges' smoke. He looks like no one; that is his trade.
people.subject: The moment: standing in light rain in a rain cape with the hood up, lips moving in a silent count, eyes flicking to the left. Face (most important: utterly forgettable): an average, unremarkable face; neither young nor old; medium brown eyes; ordinary straight brows; a straight, average nose; a closed, neutral mouth; a small smile held ready. Rain beads on his eyelashes and runs down one cheek without his noticing. Hair: ordinary brown, short, damp, mostly under the hood. Body: middle height, middle build, narrow shoulders under the cape, unremarkable. Clothing: a long grey rain cape of oiled straw-and-hemp cloth with a hood; beneath it a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and a seven-knot black cord at the waist; a small silver star pinned at the collar hardly visible; dark boots. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted slightly with one finger ticking the air; a small folded oilcloth packet in the left; a dim lamp shape in the background. Background: blurred rainy stone wall, a gate with torches, a blur of carts. A wet torch hisses in a bracket beside the gate and the glow of a distant forge colours the low cloud. Light: flat grey rain light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a patient, bland, closed look with a small smile held ready, an ordinary face that gives a watcher nothing at all to remember.

people.imagined: On the training ground at dawn, a silent, heavy man stands with a spear planted, and slowly flexes his hands. The black-iron dust is ground into his knuckles for good. He is listening for an order that is not spoken.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a stony training ground he stands with the butt of a long spear planted in the ground and flexes his big right hand slowly, looking directly at the viewer without a word. Face: a heavy, silent, square young face; skin tanned dark; steady flat dark eyes; thick black brows; a flat, broken nose; a thick closed mouth with no sign it has ever spoken; a heavy jaw. A faint pale scar nicks the corner of his chin and his ears lie flat and close to the skull. Hair: black, short, cut square. Body: heavy and broad, thick-necked, powerful shoulders, a very big young man. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, tight sleeves, over dark-grey leather; a seven-knot black cord at the waist; no star. Hands and objects (the iron dust must read): the knuckles and the backs of both hands are grey-black, ground with black-iron dust into the pores, shining slightly like graphite and visible as dark smudged knuckles; a long spear with a heavy black iron head planted beside him. Background: blurred dawn mist over a stone ground, a ridge. A line of upright spear racks stands in the grey haze, and a thin pale band of dawn lies along the ridge. Light: cold pale dawn light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a flat, steady, silent stare, brows low and jaw set, the heavy patience of a man listening for an order that has not been spoken.

people.imagined: Kneeling at a boundary stele on the western ridge, he runs his thumb along the cut edge of a letterless carved line, a chisel in his belt, easing the whole stone a rope's length. He has told his son.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a tall grey boundary stele with one grey-dusty palm laid flat on its surface and his other hand on a chisel at his belt, he looks to the viewer with a calm, level gaze. Face: a weatherbeaten, square, calm face with grey stone dust in the creases; steady grey-brown eyes; thick brows; a broad flat nose; a firm mouth; a short stubbly grey beard. Hair: grey, cropped, with dust in it. Body: broad, solid, a mason's thick forearms and thick wrists. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, dusted with pale stone powder at the knees and sleeves, crossed collar; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar; leather apron over the front. Hands and objects: both palms are grey with stone dust never fully washed out, clearly visible; a steel chisel and a small mallet at the belt; a rope looped round the foot of the tall plain grey stele beside him, which bears only abstract carved notches. Background: blurred windy ridge and a distant pale line of steles. Light: bright clear light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: calm, honest, stubborn; moving the border by inches.

people.imagined: At the outer gate on the mountain, she lifts the heaviest weight on the rack one-handed, without effort, while a herder's child watches. She is thinking about the beam no one can pity.
people.subject: The moment: at a weight rack she lifts a big round grey stone weight easily with one hand at shoulder height and looks kindly but firmly at the viewer. Face: a short, broad, tough, kindly face, weathered and ruddy like a herder's; small brown eyes; thick straight brows; a wide flat nose; a wide, firm mouth; sun lines. Her cheeks are flushed with wind and a small gap shows between her front teeth. Hair: black with grey, in two thick braids pinned across the top. Body: short, very broad, shoulders and arms like a herder's, forearms like bundles of rope. Clothing: a thick yak-wool coat in undyed grey-brown over the sect's fine grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a big round grey stone weight with a ring handle lifted one-handed; a long flat wooden beam leaning against the rack with notches along it. Background: blurred stone gate, a row of grey weights on a rack, a small child in the distance. A pale-grey cloud bank drifts behind the gate, and the child stands by a sheep at the bottom edge of the frame, barely in focus. Light: bright mountain light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a kind, firm, unhurried look, the corners of the wide mouth just lifted, the immovable calm of a woman who will not pity the child and will not leave her.

people.imagined: In a corridor, half a step ahead of his master, his jaw tight, glancing back at the girl heir behind them. He wants the Seal for the old man and he does not mind who sees it.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone corridor he strides forward, but turns his head sharply to glare back over his shoulder at the viewer, jaw set. Face: a square-jawed, restless, handsome face; skin tanned; hard dark eyes under heavy straight brows; a strong nose; a thin mouth held in a sneer; a small vertical scar between the brows. Hair: black, in a high tight knot pinned with an iron pin. A few black strands have escaped the knot and are stuck to the sweat on his temple. Body: tall, broad-chested, a duellist's athletic lean. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sharp pressed; a black cord with seven knots tied tight at the waist; a small silver star at the collar; sleeves bound with cords to the wrist. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the hilt of a straight sword at the left hip; the left hand clenched. Background: blurred long stone corridor with a pillar. Behind him another disciple walks away in the corridor, small and blurred, and a lamp hangs from the pillar. Light: cool light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: ambitious, loyal, cruel; impatient for someone else's glory.

people.imagined: At the guest forge he laughs so loud it carries to the gate, a leather apron over the guest's blue, burn-flecked forearms folded, as the guard hands him a worn blade he will reforge twice.
people.subject: The moment: at a forge he throws his head back in a huge laugh, arms folded across his chest, a tankard in one hand. Face: a big, ruddy, handsome face; sunburnt; a thick short black beard; bright brown eyes crinkled with laughter; thick arched brows; a big nose; a wide open mouth with strong white teeth. Hair: black, in a loose knot with a red sweat-cloth. A few grey hairs show in the beard and the red sweat-cloth is soaked dark at the edge. Body: big, broad, barrel-chested, strong smith's arms. Clothing: a leather apron over a guest's BLUE robe with a crossed collar (blue, not grey), with the sleeves rolled to the elbow; no star, no seven-knot cord, as he is a guest. Both forearms are flecked all over with small pale burn spots, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a tankard of dark ale in one hand; a long spear-point and a hammer on the anvil behind him. Background: blurred forge with a red-orange glow, hanging tongs. Behind him a young guard waits with a chipped blade across his arm, and a stack of dull spearheads lies on a bench. Light: orange forge light from the lower left; a faint ember fire qi hint. Expression: gregarious, greedy, arrogant; a booming guest.

people.imagined: In a borrowed yak-wool coat in the outer gate yard, cheerfully showing a classmate her inky finger. In her sleeve a pebble filed to a Metal forty's weight sits heavy.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone yard she holds up her ink-stained right forefinger with a bright, round-faced grin as if to show off, a thick borrowed coat swallowing her. Face: a round, cheerful, rosy face; bright brown eyes; soft arched brows; a small button nose; a wide smile; dimples. Her cheeks are rosy from the cold and there is a small smudge of ink on the chin. Hair: black, in two short buns tied with grey string. Body: round, small, her shoulders lost in a too-big coat. Clothing: a borrowed thick yak-wool coat in undyed grey-brown, too large, the sleeves rolled up in thick cuffs, over a plain grey robe with a crossed collar; no cord, no star, as an outer disciple. Hands and objects: the forefinger of the right hand stained black with ink to the first knuckle; in her left hand a small grey round pebble held loosely, smooth and polished. Background: blurred stone gate yard with other herders' children, a distant weight rack. Light: bright daylight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. A broad, even grey light falls on the yard and picks out the wool of the oversized coat. Expression: humble, gregarious, cautious; guilelessly cheerful.

people.imagined: On a bare ridge in dry wind, her hair standing up with static, her left foot tapping, a burn scar on one palm. She has the brass ring of an offer she means to refuse.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy ridge she stands with hair standing up in a wild halo, her left foot caught mid-tap, and a sharp challenging grin at the viewer. Face: a small, sharp, brown face; bright, quick dark eyes; strong thin brows; a pointed little nose; a thin, mocking, impatient mouth. A thin cut healed to a pink line runs over one eyebrow and her cheeks are windburnt. Hair (most important): dark brown hair standing straight up and outward in a frizzed halo of static, strands floating, clearly electric. Body: small, wiry, taut, up on the balls of her feet, one foot never still. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves bound tight with cords; a black cord with seven knots at the waist (inner disciple); no star. Hands and objects: the left palm held open and up showing a glossy round burn scar in the centre; the right hand holding a small black stone that gives off a faint violet-white spark. Background: blurred dry slope with a dark thunder cloud and pale lightning forks far away. Dry grass bends flat along the ridge and a bruise-coloured cloud bank boils on the horizon. Light: sharp white light from the upper left with pale violet sparks; a faint violet thunder qi hint. Expression: a sharp, bright, challenging grin with the chin up, eyes dancing and the mouth sharp at the corner, a girl about to say no to your face.

people.imagined: In the map room, with a roll of the great map on his shoulder, his eyes flick to the door before he answers anything. He shows visitors the older copy.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a map room with a thick roll of parchment resting on his shoulder, he glances toward the doorway before turning his gaze to the viewer. Face: a thin, pale, cautious face; large watchful grey eyes with dark rings; thin level brows; a narrow nose; a closed, thin mouth with a slight lie in it. His fingertips are grey with chalk dust and a thin line of ink lies under one thumbnail. Hair: black with grey, in a small knot with a dark pin. Body: slight, round-shouldered, with a visible hard callus-pad on the right shoulder under the cloth where rolls rest. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, ink-spotted at the cuffs; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star missing, only the collar plain. Hands and objects: the right shoulder carries a thick roll of map parchment, plain and unmarked; a long wooden map-rod in the left hand; behind him two identical rolls on the table, one yellowed with age and one newer. Background: blurred long table, hanging maps (as plain coloured shapes without writing), a dark doorway. Brass lamps hang low over the long table and the rolled maps lie in baskets along the walls, their colours muted. Light: warm dim light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a quiet, watchful stillness with tired eyes and a closed mouth, the calm of a man who keeps two truths and has practised never letting either show.

people.imagined: At a great sect's gate, he coughs a long, rattling cough, one hand on the club at his belt, before he delivers the summons. The smell of sulphur follows him in.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a gate he doubles slightly over a hard cough with his fist at his mouth, but his eyes stay fixed hard on the viewer. Face: a heavy, pitted, yellowish face with sallow skin tinged with sulphur-yellow; small hard dark eyes; thick black brows; a broken, wide nose; a thick, grim mouth behind the fist; a short black stubble. A faint sulphur-yellow dust lies in the lines beside his nose and his lips are cracked and dry. Hair: black, shaved short at the sides, a topknot bound with a leather thong. Body: short, thick-set, massive forearms, a mining-boy's barrel chest. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, a bailiff's dark leather jerkin over it; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. Hands and objects: a short, thick wooden club hanging from his belt on a leather loop worn shiny and dark with handling, clearly visible; a rolled summons tied with grey cord in his other hand, blank. Background: blurred stone gate and a flag of grey cloth. Two heavy gate doors stand banded in dark iron, and a grey banner snaps in a gust at the top of the frame. Light: hard white daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint with a yellow tinge. Expression: a stern, unmoved, hard-set look above the coughing fist, the cold justice of a man who delivers summons the way he delivers blows.

people.imagined: At the witness-house door, spreading both hands in welcome; the rings glitter on all ten fingers. He is already working out what the guest will pay for the bed.
people.subject: The moment: at an inn door he spreads both hands wide in a grand welcome toward the viewer, ten rings catching the light. Face: a round, sleek, smiling face, smooth and ruddy; bright dark eyes; thin arched brows; a small round nose; a wide, easy, practised smile; a thin black moustache. Hair: black, oiled, in a topknot with a jade pin. A single grey lock is combed carefully over each temple and the jade pin has a tiny gold cap. Body: plump, tall, a host's open posture. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, slightly richer cut, crossed collar, wide sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. The wide sleeves are lined in a subtle dark red that shows only when he spreads his arms. Hands and objects (the rings must read): ten rings, one on each finger, gold, jade and silver, large and clearly visible on spread hands; a pair of dice in a small cloth pouch hanging at the belt. Background: blurred inn doorway with lanterns and a row of seven identical doors. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Warm lantern light glints off every ring and leaves a soft shine on his cheeks. Expression: gregarious, indulgent, greedy; a smile ahead of the purse.

people.imagined: Writing the monthly letter at a desk in an alien lake-sect's guest room; she is perfectly straight-backed, her brush poised. She will laugh when she reads the reply aloud, to nobody, later.
people.subject: The moment: at a low desk she sits very upright with a brush poised over paper, her face turned politely toward the viewer. Face: a fine, narrow, pale, noble face; calm dark eyes; thin elegant brows; a straight nose; a small mouth held in a courteous almost-smile. Her skin is clear and finely lined at the eyes, with a faint blush from the warmth of the tea. Hair: black, in a tall neat bun with a dark wood pin and a small tidy loop. Body: tall, slim, a back as straight as a drawn bow, an elegant long neck. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe of excellent cut with a crossed collar, narrow sleeves; a seven-knot black cord at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a fine brush poised in the right hand; a sheet of pale paper with faint ruled lines and no writing; a small porcelain cup of tea at her elbow; a window beyond showing a pale-blue lake. Background: blurred guest room with a screen painted with lake reeds. The reed screen is painted in soft green and silver, and the window beyond shows pale water and a single distant sail. Light: cool silvery light from the upper left reflecting off water; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a composed, courteous half-smile and cool eyes, a diplomat's polish laid over a private amusement she will save for later.

people.imagined: Landing, windblown, from a crane; he rubs his bruised hip when nobody is watching, a feather in his hair and a grin. The crane preens behind him.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a tall white crane just after landing, he rubs his hip with one hand while grinning widely at the viewer, windswept. Face: a lean, tanned, cheerful face; bright brown eyes with crow's-feet; thin dark brows; a long nose; a wide boyish grin; a few days of stubble. A flush of wind and exertion reddens his cheeks and nose. Hair (most important: feathers): black hair tangled by wind, with at least four white and grey crane feathers caught in it, clearly visible. Body: lean, tall, loose-limbed, a courier's wiry frame. Clothing: a fine undyed grey travelling robe with a crossed collar, wind-rumpled, a long courier's scarf of grey; a black cord with seven knots at the waist (a little loosened); a leather satchel across the chest. Hands and objects: one hand on his hip, the other holding a coil of rope reins; beside him a tall white crane with black wing tips and a red crown, its long neck craning toward him. Background: blurred sky and distant misty peaks. High cirrus streaks the blue and a far ridge catches a bar of gold light behind the crane's folded wing. Light: bright windy daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a wide, breathless, boyish grin with bright eyes, thrown from the crane twice already and keen to go up a third time.

people.imagined: On the seat's drill ground at dawn, blowing the whistle on its cord, frost-cracked lips pulling back, the guard before him in rows. He has just shouted and is judging who will fall.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a frosty drill ground he blows a brass whistle held in his teeth with his left hand raised, two fingers missing, and glares at unseen ranks. Face: a hard, lined, ruddy face; icy blue eyes narrowed; heavy straight white brows; a broken nose; cracked, bleeding, frost-split lips around the whistle; a stubbly grey jaw. A thin line of frost clings to his stubble and his breath is a dense white cloud. Hair: grey, cropped to a brush. Body: tall, broad, tough, a drillmaster's iron posture. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, over grey leather armour; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: the LEFT hand raised in a commanding gesture with ONLY THREE fingers, the last two missing, plainly visible; the whistle on a cord at his teeth; the right hand holding a long wooden drill staff. Background: blurred misty drill ground with rows of grey figures in breath-steam. A second bank of mist hides the far end of the field, with only the tops of spears showing. Light: cold pale dawn light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: warlike, loyal, cruel; the next war starts tomorrow.

people.imagined: In a ruined beacon fort at night, soot to the elbows, turning a flint-striker over and over, while a fire basket stands ready. Others fidget; she does not. She is quietly relighting the old line.
people.subject: The moment: crouching beside an iron fire basket filled with kindling she turns a flint-striker in her black fingers, intent, with one dark eye lifted to the viewer. Face: a sharp, soot-smudged, determined face; dark intense eyes; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a firm mouth; a smear of soot across one cheek. Sweat has cut clean lines through the soot on her temple. Hair: black, tied in a tight bun with a cloth wrapped round it. Body: lean, wiry, rolled-up sleeves. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, the sleeves rolled to the shoulder; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; a leather apron. Hands and objects (the soot must read): both forearms are black with soot to the elbow, a clear sharp line where clean skin ends; a steel flint-striker and a flint in the hands; an iron fire basket filled with dry kindling. Background: blurred dark stone beacon fort, a night sky. Broken battlements stand against a sky of cold stars, and a jagged line of dark ridges runs away into the distance. Light: a small orange spark and a faint warm glow from below, cold blue night above; a faint ember fire qi hint. Expression: a calm, hard-eyed focus, mouth set and brows level, the unflinching patience of a woman relighting a dead line one spark at a time.

people.imagined: In the array chamber at dusk, standing, lighting the seventh of the seven anchor candles. Wax scars her palms and her heavy eyelids droop; she has not sat down in forty years.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk, standing beside a row of tall candles, she holds a taper to light the last one and looks drowsily at the viewer with heavy eyelids. Face: a long, pale, still face; large dark eyes with very heavy, drooping lids; thin straight brows; a long nose; a thin, calm mouth; faint shadows under the eyes. Hair: black, in a long single braid wound up in a coil and pinned. Body: tall, slim, standing perfectly straight, a body that does not sit. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, immaculate; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the wax scars must read): both palms and fingers are spotted with small shiny pale scars of candle wax, like droplets, plainly visible on the hand holding the taper; seven tall white candles in a curved row, six lit, one dark; seven small standing stones at their feet. Background: blurred dark chamber with a pale circle of floor marks. Light: warm candlelight from the lower left, many small flames; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: calm, diligent, reclusive; the array's eighth star.

people.imagined: At dawn on the vein's wall, she has climbed a stair slowly, favouring her knees, and pauses to look over the bright snow. Her pale lashes blink in the glare.
people.subject: The moment: on a stone stair at dawn she stops with one hand on her knee and the other on a wall, looking up into bright light. Face (most important: pale lashes): a pale, fine, honest face; very pale, nearly white eyelashes framing bright grey-blue eyes that blink in the glare; thin fair brows; a straight nose; a gentle mouth; faint freckles. A few strands of pale hair have worked loose and shine at her temple. Hair: pale brown, in a long loose braid pinned up in a crown. Body: slender, medium height; knees slightly bent and stiff, a careful gait. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, a heavy grey wool shawl; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a small grey stone, an array anchor stone, carried in the right hand, faintly glowing white; the left hand on her knee. Background: blurred snow-slope with a bright white sky; a row of upright stones along the wall. Frost whitens the stair edges, and the snow-light turns every shadow a pale violet. Light: bright white dawn light from the upper left, a faint light-gold hint of a light qi in the stone. Expression: a gentle, unhurried, patient look, eyes narrowed against the glare and the mouth a little parted from the climb.

people.imagined: In the open square at Song Kiều in morning noise, hoarse from shouting the weights; the ledger pad is strapped to his forearm. He holds up a lump of ore for everyone to see.
people.subject: The moment: in an open market square he holds up a lump of dark ore in his right hand and shouts a weight to the crowd, mouth open, voice cracking. Face: a broad, ruddy, honest face; bright brown eyes; thick straight brows; a wide nose; a wide open mouth in a shout, the throat tight; stubborn square jaw; grey stubble. Veins stand in his neck from the shouting and a drop of sweat hangs from his chin. Hair: black and grey, short, tied under a sweat cloth. The sweat cloth is knotted at the back and a grey tuft sticks out over the right ear. Body: stocky, strong, big-voiced, chest thrust out. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled to the elbows; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a rough dark lump of ore in the right hand; strapped to the left forearm a flat wooden ledger pad with a ruled paper, blank except for tidy tick marks; behind him a large brass balance. Background: blurred busy square with miners, carts, and an open scale. Light: bright morning light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. The sun is directly overhead and the shadow of his chin falls sharp across his throat. Expression: honest, gregarious, stubborn; hoarse.

people.imagined: At the mint, he has been handed a coin and has bitten it, though he struck it himself. The die-stamp bruise on his thumb is plain. He counts it twice.
people.subject: The moment: at a mint workbench he holds a silver coin between his front teeth in a bite, eyes rolled up suspiciously toward the viewer. Face: a thin, sharp, sallow face; small suspicious dark eyes; thin pinched brows; a long hooked nose; thin lips pulled back around the coin; a thin goatee. A thin sheen of sweat lies on his forehead and his hair has the greased shine of the furnace room. Hair: black and grey, plastered flat, a small knot. Body: thin, tense, hunched at the bench. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled and cuffed in leather; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the bruise must read): on the heel of the right thumb, a large dark purple-blue bruise in the shape of a round stamp, plainly visible as the hand holds the coin; on the bench, rows of blank silver discs in two exact piles and a small iron die; a set of small brass scales. Background: blurred mint workshop with a glowing furnace. Leather aprons hang on pegs beside the glowing furnace, and a long iron die-stamp rests on its rack. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower left, white window light from above; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a narrow-eyed, sour, wary look, lips drawn back around the coin, the suspicious attention of a man who counts twice and trusts neither count.

people.imagined: At the market's standard scale she stoops to read the balance, tall above everyone, a tiny tattooed beam-balance showing at her wrist. She has just found the cinnabar light again.
people.subject: The moment: a very tall woman stoops over a large bronze standard balance to read its beam, glancing sideways at the viewer with a level look. Face: a long, calm, pale face; level grey eyes; thin straight brows; a long straight nose; a quiet, firm mouth; high cheekbones. Fine lines run from her nose to the corners of her mouth, and the skin is dry from the sun. Hair: black with grey, in a smooth high knot with an iron pin. Body: extremely tall, taller than anyone at the market, slim, stooping gently over the scale. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and narrow sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the tattoo must read): on the inside of her right wrist, a small blue-black tattoo of a beam balance with two pans, plainly visible as her hand rests on the beam; the large bronze balance with bright round weights in a row beside it. Background: blurred market with merchants and baskets under awnings. Stalls of grain and cloth fill the plaza behind her, and merchants are kept to the soft edges of the frame. Light: bright even daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a level, fair, even look, mouth quiet and brows smooth, the calm of a woman who is exact to the last grain and expects no thanks for it.

people.imagined: At the black-iron mine mouth, shoulders like a cart-yoke; he is patient, easy, leaning on a cart loaded with a single ingot. He could carry two for a bet and often does.
people.subject: The moment: at a mine mouth he stands with one hand resting on a cart bearing a single huge black ingot, looking calmly at the viewer with a slow, easy smile. Face: a broad, heavy, dark face with black rime of iron dust in the creases of the neck and brow; calm small brown eyes; thick straight brows; a wide flat nose; a slow wide mouth; grey stubble. Grey dust has settled into the laugh lines at his eyes and a few old nicks cross his brow. Hair: black-grey, cropped, dusted grey. Body: huge, with shoulders as wide as a cart yoke, a thick neck, long gorilla arms. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, dust-stained at the hem, with a crossed collar and short sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a leather yoke-pad across the shoulders. Hands and objects: one large hand resting on a single long black iron ingot lying on a small cart; a miner's pick over the shoulder. Background: blurred dark mine entrance with timbers and lanterns. Dark pit timbers frame the entrance and a string of small lanterns marks the path into the hill. Light: warm lantern light from the lower left, cold daylight from above; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a slow, easy, contented smile with heavy-lidded eyes, the unbothered calm of an enormous man who could carry two ingots and will if you bet him.

people.imagined: On the guard wall in the cold, he says nothing for a very long time before he speaks. The left ear is notched. He is thinking about a boy with a frozen foot who must hold his post.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a wall parapet in the cold he turns heavy-browed eyes toward the viewer and says nothing, jaw set. Face (most important: heavy brows and notched ear): a hard, square, weathered face; very heavy, thick, shaggy black brows shadowing small dark eyes; the LEFT ear has a clear notch bitten out of its edge; a broad nose; a thick closed mouth; a short black stubble. Deep lines run from his nose to the corners of the mouth, and frost sits white in the brows. Hair: black, cropped short. Short black bristles stand even over the whole skull and a thin white scar crosses behind the right ear. Body: broad, dense, a statue of a man. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar over dark grey armour with a fur collar; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands folded on the pommel of a long straight sword planted in front of him; breath-steam in the cold. Background: blurred stone wall, a snow slope, a watch lantern. Light: cold blue-white light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: brave, loyal, callous; a long silence. His gaze is level and unhurried, as of a man who will outwait anyone.

people.imagined: At dusk on the wall, he squints toward the shut gate across the valley, half lifts his hand in a wave, and lowers it. Nobody has waved back since 1189.
people.subject: The moment: on a wall at dusk he squints across a valley with one hand half-raised in a wave he is stopping in mid-air. Face (most important: the squint): a thin, boyish, tanned face; eyes squeezed into a sentry's squint with deep lines at their corners; thin brows; a long thin nose; a slightly open, hopeful mouth that begins to close; wispy first moustache. The skin around his eyes is white where the squint has creased it and his lips are chapped. Hair: black, short, a little spiky. A plain grey cloth is tied round his brow and a few wisps stick up behind it. Body: thin, tall for his age, a bit hunched. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar over grey leather armour; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted halfway in a hesitating wave; the left on a spear shaft; a distant shut gate of a fort far across a blue valley. Background: blurred twilight valley, a far fort with a small light. Light: orange-pink dusk light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: brave, fickle, trusting; hoping. Hope drains out of his eyes as the hand slowly drops.

people.imagined: Dusting the old stones of the bridge in the store room, a pinch of incense ash on her cheek. She keeps the ash to sell and is calm about it.
people.subject: The moment: in a storeroom she holds a soft cloth to a small grey stone on a shelf, looking round with neat composure and a smudge of ash on her cheek. Face: a smooth, prim, round face; calm brown eyes; neat thin brows; a small straight nose; a small tidy mouth; a smudge of grey ash on one cheek. A pair of fine lines sits between her brows from years of careful counting. Hair: black with grey, in a prim tight bun with a wooden pin. Body: small, neat, round-shouldered. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, perfectly clean, crossed collar buttoned neatly, narrow sleeves with ash on the cuffs; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a cloth and a small weathered grey stone block in the hands; on a shelf behind her, rows of identical round grey pottery jars of ash and a censer with a thin line of scented smoke. Background: blurred storeroom with sacks and boxes. Sacks stand stacked to the ceiling beams and one lantern throws a soft yellow circle on the flagstones. Light: warm light from the upper left, pale smoke haze; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a calm, neat, prim face with the smallest satisfied tuck at the mouth, the modest look of a woman who keeps the ash to sell and is entirely at ease about it.

people.imagined: On the harbour wall in a sea breeze, with a gold hoop in one ear, rolling on her feet as if the deck were moving. She is looking at the old harbour master's house and thinking about when he will die.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a pier with a rolling sailor's stance, arms folded and chin lifted, a bright gold hoop glinting in one ear. Face: a sharp, tanned, handsome face; keen green eyes; strong arched brows; a straight nose; a bold, thin-lipped smile with impatience in it; sea-weathered lines. Fine salt-whitened lines run beside her eyes, and a thin pale scar crosses the chin. Hair: black, tied in a high tail with a faded blue cloth, loose strands whipped by wind. Body: strong, lean, sea legs apart, hips swaying. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar over a short sea-blue jerkin; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a large gold hoop earring in the left ear; a brass spyglass in her right hand; a small bag of coin at her belt. Background: blurred harbour with three small boats and a pale sea. Light: bright sea light from the upper left, a glint on the hoop; a faint blue water qi hint. Sunlight off the water throws a quivering net of light across her face and neck. Expression: brave, impatient, greedy; waiting for a dead man's chair.

people.imagined: Pre-dawn at the great gate, lantern in hand, he leans against the pillar he has leaned on for forty years, ready to throw the bar so that the city may wake before the sun.
people.subject: The moment: before dawn he stands beside a huge gate pillar with a lantern held in his forearm, in the stoop of long leaning, looking out at the viewer. Face: a lean, mild, patient face, long and grooved with lines; tired grey eyes; thin grey brows; a long nose; a calm mouth; a clean-shaven jaw. The lantern warms the lined planes of his cheekbones from below. Hair: grey, tied in a plain knot. Body: tall, stooped, leaning to one side as if his shoulder had worn a hollow in the pillar. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and long sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the scar must read): on the forearm, a pale crescent-shaped scar from an old lantern burn, clearly visible on the bare arm holding the lantern; a round paper lantern glowing warm gold; a wooden gate-bar in the other hand. Background: blurred huge gate with the morning star bright in a dark blue sky. The huge gate stands shut behind him with its iron studs picking up small orange glints, and the last stars fade over the city wall. Light: warm lantern gold from below and cold blue pre-dawn above; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a tired, mild, loyal patience with soft lines at the eyes, the face of a man who has been opening this gate for forty years and would not know what else to do.

people.imagined: At the pill furnace, lifting a lid, her cheeks flushed from the heat, her wrists red with cinnabar. She knows what the pouches are for and does not ask more.
people.subject: The moment: at a pill furnace she lifts a heavy lid with a cloth and her face flushes red in the rising heat as she looks coolly at the viewer. Face: a round, flushed face with high red colour on the cheeks; narrow dark eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a closed, cold mouth; a sheen of sweat. A drop of sweat hangs at her jawline and the heat has darkened her lashes. Hair: black, in a tight knot under a grey cloth cap. Body: short, strong, sturdy, a worker's build. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled and tied back; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a leather apron; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the red wrists must read): both wrists and forearms stained deep cinnabar-red, a bright vermilion that looks like paint, clearly visible; a clay furnace with its lid in her hand, rising pink steam; rows of small brown pill jars on a shelf. Background: blurred alchemy room, copper pots, a red glow. Copper pots gleam in rows along the wall and the furnace mouth glows through a haze of rosy steam. Light: orange-red furnace light from the lower left; a faint ember fire qi hint. Expression: a cool, flushed, incurious calm, narrow eyes steady and the mouth closed, a woman who knows what the pouches are for and has chosen not to ask.

people.imagined: On a road, a satchel on her hip, she stops and drums her fingers on it in a tune she hopes nobody hears. The tune is one of his. She is learning in secret.
people.subject: The moment: on a country road she stands with her fingers drumming on a leather satchel at her hip and a faraway, secretly happy look. Face: a gentle, thin, young face; large soft brown eyes lifted dreamily; fine curved brows; a small nose; a small shy smile. A faint flush has risen at her cheekbones and her eyelashes are long and dark. Hair: black, in two loose braids pinned up, windblown. Body: slender, thin-calved, narrow-shouldered, a walker's build. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, hem dusty from the road, sleeves tied back; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. The grey hem is dusty to the knee, and a worn leather strap crosses her chest. Hands and objects: the fingertips of the right hand drumming on a brown leather satchel with a brass buckle; a rolled letter tucked into her belt (blank); a walking staff in the left hand. A small bamboo flute-case is half hidden under her left arm, though she keeps it covered with her sleeve. Background: blurred road lined with pines under a pale sky. Light: soft daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint and a green wood hint. Dappled light through pine boughs moves across her satchel. Expression: loyal, humble, trusting; secretly humming.

people.imagined: Dozing behind the censers when the hall empties, sandalwood smoke in his clothes. His eyelids droop by noon, and he starts awake when the fire hisses.
people.subject: The moment: behind a large bronze censer, he sits slumped with eyes half closed and head nodding, then jerks, startled, his eyes wide on the viewer. Face: a young, round, soft, innocent face; large sleepy eyes with drooping lids; thin brows; a flat small nose; a slack open mouth; a soot smudge on one cheek. A faint smear of grey ash is across his forehead and his lashes are long and soft. Hair: black, cropped, a bit messy. A few strands of his cropped hair stand on end from the nap and a wisp of smoke curls through them. Body: slight, slumped, a servant's thin shoulders. He sits with his knees drawn up and his back resting against a big bronze censer's foot, a bit slack. Clothing: a plain servant's tunic of undyed grey hemp, clean and neat, with a crossed collar and short sleeves; no cord, no star; a rope belt; sandals. The tunic is neatly mended at both elbows with matching grey thread and smells of sandalwood. Hands and objects: a long iron poker in his lap and a basket of pale scented wood chips beside him; thin white smoke curling round him. Background: blurred hall with huge bronze censers and pillars, haze. Light: warm gold light from the upper left through smoke; a faint green wood qi hint. Expression: humble, lazy, trusting; sleepy.

people.imagined: At dawn in the deer meadow, an old man speaks softly to a hind that has put her nose into his hand. He has never spoken so gently to a person.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in a meadow at dawn an old man holds out an open palm to a young deer that is nuzzling it, his face soft with tenderness. Face: a thin, gentle, old, lined face; faded blue eyes; wispy white brows; a long straight nose; a soft smile; a thin white beard. Tiny brown freckles of age dot his temples and his eyes are damp with feeling. Hair: white, wispy, in a small knot with a wooden pin. A tuft of deer hair has caught in his beard. Body: thin, bent, kneeling with long careful hands. His knees are padded against the wet grass with a folded cloth. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe, soft with washing, crossed collar, wide sleeves; no cord and no star; the cuffs stained with rusty-brown antler velvet, clearly visible as brown smears. Hands and objects: an open palm with salt held out; a young brown deer with soft pale spots and velvet-covered small antlers; a shepherd's crook beside him. A little salt shines in his palm and the hind's breath makes a faint mist against it. Background: blurred misty meadow, tall grasses and pale birch trunks. Light: soft pink dawn light from the upper left; a faint green wood qi hint. Mist glows silver-white behind him and each dewdrop on the grass catches the sun. Expression: a soft, wet-eyed tenderness, brows lifted and the mouth gently open, the gentleness of a man who has never been this kind to a person.

people.imagined: Alone on the Level Beam at dusk, training twice as long as the others, with a stone weight in each hand and her square chin lifted, sweat shining.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a training ground she stands with a round grey stone weight held in each hand at her sides, chin lifted stubbornly, sweat on her brow. Face: a square, broad, sun-red young face; a strong square chin; steady brown eyes; thick straight brows; a short nose; a firm closed mouth; sunburnt ears sticking out. Her cheeks are blotched red with effort and sweat runs down her temple. Hair: brown, in a thick single braid down the back. A few sweat-darkened strands stick to her brow and the braid is tied with a plain hemp string. Body: stocky, strong, broad-shouldered. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and short sleeves, no cord or star; both wrists show many tiny pale nicks and scratches from barley awns, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a round grey stone weight in each hand; a long wooden beam on trestles before her. Background: blurred dusk yard, a few other trainees, a rail. Beyond the beam stand a pale rack of weights and a low barley field turning gold. Light: warm low dusk light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. The low gold sun sets a bright rim on her chin and shoulder. Expression: a stubborn, shining, tight-lipped determination, chin raised and brow damp, a girl who will keep training after the others have gone in.

people.imagined: Sitting on the weight-rack with a knucklebone game going, calling out a bet while another boy carries his weights. His toes splay in his sandals.
people.subject: The moment: sprawled on a bench he shakes a handful of knucklebones in a fist and grins, wagering with a friend off to the side. Face: a broad, cheerful, sleepy-eyed young face; sunburnt; half-lidded brown eyes with a gambler's glint; thick brows; a snub nose; a wide, easy grin. A shadow of first stubble is on the chin and a tiny scar sits in the left eyebrow. Dimples show in both cheeks when he grins. Hair: black, cropped, uneven. A small bit of straw is tucked behind one ear. Body: stocky, lazy, a carter's thick legs. He sits with his knees apart and one elbow propped on his thigh. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe, rumpled, with a crossed collar and sleeves pushed up; no cord or star; wide cart-boy's toes spread in open sandals, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a fist full of small white knucklebones, a few scattered on the bench; a pocket bulging and rattling; a bowl of barley dumplings. Background: blurred yard with a weight rack and a boy staggering with stone weights. Light: bright afternoon light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Hard afternoon sun throws crisp shadows from the bench legs across his sandals. Expression: a lazy, sunburnt, gambler's grin with half-closed eyes, the carefree look of a boy who is sure the next throw will be his.

people.imagined: In the kitchen she has a heavy pot held out in each hand like weights, practising, face pink from the stove, and a smear of flour up her arms.
people.subject: The moment: in a kitchen she holds a heavy iron cooking pot in each outstretched hand like practice weights, her round face pink with effort. Face: a round, pale, curd-white face flushed pink over the cheeks; kind small brown eyes; soft thin brows; a button nose; a shy smile. A fleck of flour whitens one eyebrow. Hair: light brown, in a thick plait coiled and tied with a cloth. A few loose strands are stuck to her damp forehead by flour-dusted fingers. Body: round, short, sturdy. She stands with her elbows locked and her whole round frame braced against the weight. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled to the elbow; an undyed linen apron; no cord or star. Hands and objects: flour to the elbows, white and thick, visible; two heavy iron pots held out level; a bowl of cream curd on the table behind her. Her knuckles are white around the pot handles and the cooking pots shine dark and clean. Background: blurred kitchen with hanging pans, a hearth fire. Light: warm firelight from the lower left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Steam rises in a soft white veil across the lower half of the picture. Expression: a shy, round, pink-cheeked smile of patient effort, lips pressed and eyes bright, quietly pleased that she can still hold the pots level.

people.imagined: Standing in the yard with the falcon on his glove, the gauntlet never taken off. The bird's eye follows the pigeons on the roof. He is looking at them with a smile that does not reach his eyes.
people.subject: The moment: in a yard he stands with a leather gauntlet raised bearing a hooded-eyed brown falcon, and looks to the viewer with a faint, arrogant smile. Face (most important: the talon scar): a sharp, handsome, sunburnt face; three parallel pale scars slashing down from under the LEFT eye across the cheek, clearly visible; keen amber-brown eyes; thin arched brows; a hooked nose; a thin cruel smile. Hair: black, cropped short with a high topknot. A thin leather cord ties the topknot and a few black strands blow across his forehead. Body: lean, upright, proud. His shoulders are held square and his back straight, the gauntleted arm raised steady as a post. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and tight sleeves, no cord or star; a thick brown leather gauntlet on the whole left forearm. Hands and objects: the falcon, brown barred with a pale breast, gripping the gauntlet with large yellow talons; a leather jess in his hand. Background: blurred stone yard roof with several pale pigeons perched. Light: bright daylight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. The falcon's brown feathers catch a bright rim of light and it glares at the viewer. Expression: brave, arrogant, cruel; a hunter amusing himself.

people.imagined: Pouring a cup from a wine-skin for a debtor, grinning with a missing canine, thumb over the skin's mouth as he waters it. He is watching how much the debtor trusts him.
people.subject: The moment: he tilts a leather wine-skin to pour pale mare's-milk wine into a cup with a big steppe grin, one eye on the viewer's face. Face (most important: the missing canine): a broad, weathered, red-brown face; broad cheekbones; narrow black eyes crinkled in a grin; thin brows; a flat wide nose; a huge grin with an upper canine tooth plainly missing, a dark gap in the smile; a thin black moustache. Hair: black, in a long single braid with a leather tie. The braid is greasy with mutton fat and tied off with a bright red leather thong. Body: stocky, bow-legged, a rider's frame. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, no cord or star; a leather wine-skin slung over the shoulder and a second belted at the waist, worn like a second belt. Hands and objects: the wine-skin in his right hand pouring into a small clay cup; his left thumb over the water-hole. Background: blurred yard with a dusty wall and a camel's head. Light: bright light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. The sun is low and the wine in the cup glows amber, throwing a pale reflection on his chin. Expression: gregarious, fickle, greedy.

people.imagined: On the wall at dusk, chapped lips, her eyes looking past the stone to the plain. The eagle-bone charm in her hair clicks in the wind. She wants one place to stay and cannot stop looking out.
people.subject: The moment: on a wall in the wind she gazes far past the viewer toward a horizon, chin lifted, the wind pulling her hair. Face: a lean, tanned, wind-chapped face; very pale cracked lips; wide dark eyes fixed on a far distance; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a closed mouth. Hair: long black hair in many thin braids blown sideways, with a small white eagle-bone charm carved like a feather braided into one braid, clearly visible. Body: slim, wiry, tall. Her boots are planted on the parapet's edge and she leans a little into the wind, one hand clenched on a braid. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, a thick sheepskin vest, no cord or star; a woven red-and-brown nomad sash at the waist. Hands and objects: a hand gripping the wall's edge; a short bow slung on her back. Background: blurred vast yellow steppe and pale sky, a small herd far away. In the far haze a line of small dark yurts and a thread of smoke rise from the plain. Light: wind-washed low sunlight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: fickle, brave, reclusive; always half elsewhere. Her eyes hold the unfocused look of someone counting the days to the spring move.

people.imagined: Leaning with his ear to a wall, tapping it with a knuckle, listening to its answer, grey mortar dust on his hands. He is learning to fail better.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a stone wall with one ear pressed to it, he taps the stone with a knuckle and listens with eyes closed. Face: a calm, round, open face; thick-lidded closed eyes; thick brows; a broad nose; a mild small smile; a mortar-grey smudge on one cheek. A faint grey fleck of mortar sits in his eyebrow and he has a calm line between the brows. His lashes lie dark against his cheeks and his breathing is slow. Hair: brown, short and curly, with grey dust in it. Body: sturdy, broad, medium height, a mason's hands. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled and dusty; no cord or star; a leather tool belt. Hands and objects: both hands pale mortar-grey to the wrist, clearly visible; a small mason's hammer and a plumb line weight hanging from the belt; a stone wall of squared blocks. A short plumb line hangs at his belt and the hammer's wooden handle is dark with grip. Background: blurred wall and scaffold. Squared grey blocks fill the picture behind him, each joint straight and the lines of mortar like pale threads. Light: soft grey daylight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a calm, listening stillness with the eyes closed and a mild half-smile, the humble patience of a man learning to fail better.

people.imagined: In a north wind, a sparring stance, flushed cheeks like hot coals, plait ends singed. She has chosen her opponent by the weather and is already grinning.
people.subject: The moment: in a sparring yard in a strong wind she stands in a fighting crouch, fists up, grinning fiercely at the viewer with flushed red cheeks. Face (most important: the fire-red cheeks): a round, strong young face with vivid hot red cheeks as if scorched; bright dark brown eyes; thick straight brows; a short nose; a wide fierce grin. A line of sweat runs from her temple to her jaw, and her nostrils flare with each breath. Her ears are scarlet and a damp curl clings to her cheek. Hair: dark brown, in a single plait whose ends are singed, black, frizzled and short. Body: sturdy, compact, planted, shoulders forward. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and sleeves bound at the wrists; no cord or star. Hands and objects: both fists raised and wrapped in cloth; a faint red heat shimmer round her hands; a wooden training staff leaning at the side. Cloth wraps run from her knuckles up to the wrist in tight spirals. Background: blurred sparring ground with a flag whipping in the wind. Light: bright harsh light from the upper left; a faint ember fire qi hint. A hard bright glare lies on her forehead, and tiny sparks of orange seem to glow at her knuckles. Expression: a fierce, laughing, hot-blooded grin with narrowed bright eyes, a girl who has chosen her opponent by the weather and cannot wait.

people.imagined: Sweeping the barrow steps in autumn with a broom he oils like a blade, rolling gait, calm among the mounds, goat bells jingling in memory.
people.subject: The moment: on a long flight of old stone steps he sweeps with a broom held like a staff, looking up with a calm patient look. Face: a lean, weathered, dark, calm face; mild brown eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a small closed mouth; a wispy stubble. His ears are large and his shoulders are bony beneath the plain cloth, and a small dry smile is on his lips. A stubble of black bristles shadows his jaw. Hair: black, in a short knot, a straw hat on his back. A little dust and a single red maple leaf are caught in his hair. Body: long-legged, easy, a goatherd's rolling stride. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe, rough-spun but clean, with a crossed collar and short sleeves; no cord or star; goat-hide leggings. The grey robe is rough-spun and sun-faded but laundered clean, and the leggings are neatly laced. Hands and objects: a stout besom broom with a very dark, polished handle gleaming with oil, held like a weapon; autumn leaves on the steps. Background: blurred long stone steps, a green grave mound, red autumn leaves. Light: golden low light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. The low sun lights the dust rising from each sweep of the broom. Expression: a calm, dry, loyal half-smile with steady eyes, an easy patience among the quiet mounds.

people.imagined: At the rice pot lending grains at two for one, the string of copper cash around her neck clicking, a sly merchant's calm. Her heels are cracked from the road.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a rice pot with a scoop in her hand and a sly, friendly smile, a loop of copper coins swinging at her neck. Face: a lively, round, tanned face; sharp bright dark eyes; thin arched brows; a small nose; a wide mouth in a bargaining smile. A dusting of freckles spreads across her nose and she has a small gap between the front teeth. Hair: black, in a high ponytail with a red cord. The red cord is tied in a neat bow and the tail swings with her movement. Body: short, strong, a walker's calves. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and short sleeves; no cord or star; bare feet in sandals with deeply cracked heels. Hands and objects (the coins must read): a long string of copper coins with square holes looped many times round her neck, clearly visible; a rice scoop in her right hand; a pot of white rice. Background: blurred dining yard, benches, a smoky kitchen. A line of unmistakable camel silhouettes is faintly visible at the edge of the yard. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: gregarious, greedy, brave.

people.imagined: Dozing on the weight-rack in the sun with his big shaggy dog asleep across his lap, hair all over his coat; he is trusting the dog to guard.
people.subject: The moment: sitting against a rack asleep, head tipped back, with a large shaggy grey dog sprawled across his lap. Face: a mild, sleepy, tanned face; closed eyes; thin brows; a flat nose; a loose half-open mouth. His lips are cracked and a tiny line of drool shines on his chin. A line of sun lies across his closed eyelids and his nose is peeling. Hair: brown, tousled. A long grey dog hair is stuck to his lower lip and shifts with his breath. Body: sturdy, loose, relaxed. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar; no cord or star; the coat is covered in long grey and white dog hairs, clearly visible, clinging in drifts over the chest and sleeves. Hands and objects: a callus on the right palm showing as one hand rests open on the dog's back; a shepherd's staff beside him; the shaggy grey dog with one open watchful eye. The dog's chin rests heavy on his knee and its one open eye is dark and calm. Background: blurred weight rack of round grey stones. A broad pale sky above the rack and a small gate with a lantern behind. Light: warm sun from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a slack, trusting, blissful doze, the lips loose and the brow smooth, a young man who has handed the guarding to the dog.

people.imagined: Cross-legged on the ground, counting breaths on a cord, tying a knot at each one, the red rope-burn rings round her fingers, while someone has asked to see her knots.
people.subject: The moment: sitting cross-legged she ties a knot in a thin cord between her fingers, counting a breath, eyes lowered, serious. Face: a thin, quiet, serious young face; downcast dark eyes with long lashes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a small closed mouth. A small crease of concentration is between her brows and her lower lip is caught in her teeth. Her ears are small and pale, and a fine down shows on her cheek in the light. Hair: black, in a tight braid coiled at the back. A thin braided cord, itself knotted, is woven through the braid. Body: slender, upright, small. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar; no cord or star; her cuffs have a row of braided cords and tiny knots sewn into them, clearly visible. Hands and objects: raised rope-burn rings, pale red bands, round several fingers of both hands; a long thin cord with many neat knots in a row, trailing across her lap. Her fingers are slim and quick and the rope-burn rings stand out raw against pale skin. Background: blurred plain stone floor and a wall. A stack of coiled rope hangs on a peg and a spindle sits on the wall. Light: soft light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a quiet, serious, absorbed concentration, eyes lowered and lips pressed, a girl who would rather be left alone with her knots.

people.imagined: At a table in the dining hall, his knee jiggling beneath it, laughing too loudly at his own story of the gorge; the whole room has stopped to look.
people.subject: The moment: at a table he throws back his head in a huge laugh, one fist banging the table, the knee beneath it visibly bouncing. Face: a broad, tanned, merry face; bright dark eyes squeezed in laughter; thick arched brows; a big nose; a wide open mouth with white teeth; windburn on cheeks. His eyes are wet with laughter and there is a nick on his chin from a hasty shave. Laugh creases fan out at his eyes and his throat is flushed. Hair: black, short and wild, with a wet-looking curl on the brow. A rope-fibre tuft is caught in the damp curls. Body: broad-shouldered, strong river-hardened arms, restless. His free hand slaps his thigh and his shoulders shake. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled up; no cord or star; a blue river-scarf at the neck. Hands and objects: a fist on the table; a wooden bowl and a pair of chopsticks scattered; a coil of rope over the shoulder. Background: blurred dining hall with long benches and faces turned toward him. Light: warm hall light from the upper left; a faint ember fire qi hint. Warm light from a high window falls across his face and leaves the roomful of onlookers in soft shadow.
