Expression: a loud, wet-eyed, helpless roar of laughter with the head thrown back, the face of a man who can never be quiet and is delighted by it.

people.imagined: Stitching a winter coat by lamplight, a needle in her fingertips, felt fuzz clinging to her sleeves like frost. She is behind in the primer and does not mind.
people.subject: The moment: sitting with a thick grey felt coat across her lap, she pulls a needle through and looks up warmly at the viewer. Face: a soft, round, kind face; gentle brown eyes; soft curved brows; a small nose; a small smile. Her eyelids are slightly pink from long evenings of sewing and a thin white thread is stuck to her lip. A few pale freckles lie across her nose. Hair: black, in a bun covered with a grey cloth, a pin cushion pinned at the temple. A few white felt-fibres are caught in the loose strands over her temple. Body: small, round-shouldered, hunched over the work. Her shoulders curve forward over the work and her feet are tucked under her. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar; no cord or star; the sleeves are covered all over with white felt fuzz like frost, clearly visible. Hands and objects: the fingertips of both hands are dotted with tiny red needle-prick marks; a needle and thick thread; a heap of grey winter coats beside her. Background: blurred workshop with felt rolls. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. The lamp's flame is reflected small and bright in both her eyes. Expression: a soft, humble, patient smile with warm eyes, the kind look of a girl who is behind in her primer and entirely unbothered.

people.imagined: Filing his fingernails to a point with a small file, eyes darting round the yard, hand resting on a stone weight he has filed a hair light.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a weight rack he draws a small steel file along a fingernail while his sharp eyes dart sideways at the viewer and beyond. Face (most important: darting eyes): a narrow, sharp, clever face; quick dark eyes caught mid-dart, whites showing at one side; thin pointed brows; a thin nose; a thin smirk. A thin line of sweat sits on his upper lip and a pulse is visible at his temple. His cheekbones are sharp and the skin under them is a little hollow. Hair: black, slicked, in a neat tight knot. Two sharp strands fall forward onto his brow and he flicks them back with his head. Body: thin, wiry, always poised. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar; no cord or star; sleeves neat. Hands and objects: the fingernails are filed to sharp points, clearly visible; a small steel nail-file; beside him a rack with a round grey weight that is slightly smaller than its neighbours. Background: blurred yard with the Level Beam, other disciples. The long beam stands out dim behind him and a pair of disciples carry weights past in soft focus. Light: cool light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a thin, quick smirk that stops before it reaches the eyes, which keep sliding sideways, the look of a man who has already weighed the room.

people.imagined: Reading a letter moving his lips, silk cord on a cheap wooden token, promising a boy payment for carrying his weights, and not noticing the promise is not kept.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a small paper held in both hands he mouths the words as he reads, brow furrowed. Face: a plump, soft, pleasant face; small round brown eyes; thin high brows; a small nose; lips visibly moving. Pink cheeks and a faint double chin, with a frown of effort between the brows as he reads. A thin gloss of oil shines on his nose. Hair: black, glossy, in a neat topknot. The topknot is tied with a ribbon of real silk, the same red as the cord at his chest. Body: plump, soft-shouldered, a merchant's son. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe of slightly finer cloth with a crossed collar; no cord or star; at his chest a cheap wooden token on a rich red silk cord, the token plain and the cord glossy, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a small blank paper; a small abacus on a thong at his belt; a second boy, out of focus, carrying a heavy stone weight behind him. Background: blurred yard with a weight rack. Pale stone, the corner of a wooden bench and a ring of boys at the edge of the yard. Light: soft light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Soft light from the left shows the sheen of a lightly oiled forehead. Expression: a puzzled, pleased, moist-lipped frown of effort, brow furrowed over the words, a man who is sure he has been generous and never counts the cost.

people.imagined: Surfacing in thought: a long, slow diver's breath held in, her salt-white eyebrow streak lifted, and she laughs, her ears popping.
people.subject: The moment: she draws a long, deep, slow breath, chest lifted, then bursts into soft laughter, a hand rising to an ear. Face (most important: the salt-white eyebrow streak): a calm, broad, tanned face; a clear streak of salt-white in the LEFT eyebrow like a stripe of chalk; clear grey-green eyes; a small straight nose; a wide laughing mouth. Water beads on her lashes and her cheeks are pink with cold. Hair: wet-dark brown, in a single plait over her shoulder, a few strands stuck to her neck. Her hair is slicked back with seawater and drips slowly onto her collar. Body: strong, broad-shouldered, a diver's deep chest. Her shoulders are tanned and freckled and the collar of her robe is damp. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and short sleeves; no cord or star; a hemp cord at the waist with a small mother-of-pearl shell. Hands and objects: one hand lifted to the ear, the other holding a small white pearl between two fingers. Background: blurred wall and sea sky. A strip of pale sea and a line of white gulls over the wall, a small boat far out. Light: bright sea light from the upper left; a faint blue water qi hint. The sun makes a bright reflection on the damp skin of her collarbone. Expression: a calm, glad, breathless laugh, eyes bright and the mouth wide, the relief of a girl who has surfaced and is generous with it.

people.imagined: On the war-hall yard, ready, with a broken nose, a heavy ore-hauler's neck bulging, hand on his sword. He has been told the war is coming and he cannot wait.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone yard he stands braced with one hand on a sword hilt and his chin lowered, eyes burning toward the viewer. Face (most important: the broken nose): a rugged, square, young face; his nose is visibly broken across the bridge, a flattened, crooked, thickened lump, clearly the focus; fierce dark eyes; thick straight brows; a thin firm mouth. A fine scar crosses his chin, and his jaw is hard-set with the muscles standing at the hinge. Hair: black, in a tight topknot. The topknot is tied with a strip of grey leather and a few hairs are stuck to the sweat on his neck. Body: very thick neck, broad, powerful shoulders and hauler's trapezius muscles. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, tight sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. Hands and objects: the right hand on the hilt of a straight sword in a plain dark sheath; the left clenched. Background: blurred yard with a rank of spears, a banner of plain grey cloth. Light: hard light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Strong light picks out each ridge of the broken nose and the scar on his chin. Expression: brave, ambitious, diligent; eager for war.

people.imagined: In the array chamber, she cocks her head toward a faint hum from one of the seven stones and her gold-flecked freckles catch the light. She has felt one anchor dim.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim chamber she tilts her head sharply to one side, listening with eyes unfocused, as if she heard a faint hum. Face (most important: gold-flecked freckles): a pale, narrow, intent face; across the nose and cheeks, freckles speckled with real tiny flecks of gold that glint, clearly visible; wide grey eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a small parted mouth. Hair: copper-brown, in a tight bun with an iron pin. A few copper strands escape the bun and curl around her ears. Body: slender, upright, attentive. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and tight sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. Hands and objects: one hand raised, fingers spread, as if feeling a hum in the air; behind her, seven small standing stones in a curved row, one of them visibly dimmer than the others. Background: blurred dim chamber with faint glowing circle lines. Light: soft pale light from the standing stones and cool light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint with gold glints. Expression: calm, diligent, paranoid; listening. Her eyes are unfocused and her lips slightly parted, as if she were listening to a distant note.

people.imagined: Among the boundary steles of Giới Bi Phong he is propped on one elbow against a slab, chalk to the shoulders, bored, flipping a coin, calculating how much a drink is worth against his father's hidden measuring book.
people.subject: The moment: lounging against a tall grey stele on a windy ridge, he flips a copper coin with his thumb and looks at the viewer with a bored, sly half-smile. Face: a narrow, handsome, sulky young face; brown skin tinged with pale dust; heavy-lidded brown eyes that droop; thin dark brows, one higher than the other; a straight nose; a drooping, bored lower lip with a small cocky curl at one corner. Hair: black, messy, tied in a loose knot with a bit of grey string, strands falling over his forehead. Body: tall and slouched, long limbs, one hip against the stone, arms loose. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and a black cord with seven knots at the waist, rumpled; the sleeves are chalk-white from shoulder to cuff, thickly powdered as if he had been rubbing them along the stones, clearly visible; no star; cloth shoes scuffed with pale dust. Hands and objects: a copper coin tumbling over the right thumb; the left hand hooked in his cord; a short chalk-line reel hanging unused at his belt. Background: a row of tall grey steles marching off along a windy ridge, plain, with only abstract chisel notches, and a pale sky. Light: flat bright afternoon light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: gregarious, impatient, faithless; bought for the price of a cup.

people.imagined: On the outer gate yard at morning, an old man who failed the beam eleven times in eighty years and passed on the twelfth stands by a weight rack. A heavy weight is named and his shoulders lift by habit, a boy's habit in a century-old body.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a rack of round stone weights, a very old man's shoulders rise by themselves at the sound of a weight being named, and he turns his head with a gentle, patient smile toward the viewer. Face (most important: great age and the wheat-straw beard): a deeply lined, sun-browned, kindly face with a thousand folds like old leather; a long, thin, wispy beard of pale straw-yellow shot with white, hanging to the chest; pale, watery blue eyes full of patience; thin white brows; a broad nose with a red tip; a mild smile showing few teeth. Hair: sparse white wisps, tied in a tiny knot on top. Body: tall, frail, thin and bony, yet the shoulders square and lifted; huge knotted farmer's hands. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe, worn very soft with a lifetime of washing but clean, crossed collar, short sleeves exposing thin brown forearms; no cord, no star; cloth shoes. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on a big round grey stone weight on the rack; the left holds a farmer's walking staff. Background: blurred stone gate yard, a long weight rack with graded grey stones, a few young disciples. Light: soft clear morning light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: patient, humble, content; a farmer who finally passed.

people.imagined: At the Bridge Court's side table she is copying a hearing, lips moving with each word, right hand cramped, and she has noticed that the rulings in her record run shorter than in the judge's. She glances up, still mouthing.
people.subject: The moment: at a low table she writes with a brush while her lips silently form each word she is hearing, then she glances up at the viewer with a worried, careful look. Face: a thin, pale, tired, intelligent face; large dark attentive eyes with faint shadows; thin straight brows; a narrow nose; lips slightly parted and moving; a small crease at each corner of the mouth. Hair: black with a little grey, parted and pinned in a very tight low bun with a plain wooden pin. Body: slight, bent to the desk, the right shoulder higher than the left from years of writing. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and narrow sleeves tied back with cords; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; cuffs spotted with ink. Hands and objects: the right hand held in a cramped claw around a brush, the knuckles swollen and the fingers curled, plainly visible; a long scroll of pale paper filled with ruled columns (only lines, no letters) unrolling over the table's edge; a stone ink-slab and a small water dropper. Background: blurred court room, the dark shapes of benches and a high window with grey light. Light: cool grey light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: honest, patient, cautious; recording everything, including the silence.

people.imagined: In the archive, between shelves at the end of the day, his head tilted toward the boxes as if they were whispering, copying the one shelf for the year, trusting and content.
people.subject: The moment: standing between two tall shelves of lacquered boxes he tilts his head to one side, listening, as if the boxes whispered, a brush held idle in one hand. Face: a soft, round, gentle, pale face; large, mild, brown eyes; thin soft brows; a short soft nose; a small contented smile; a faint shadow of stubble; a slightly double chin. Hair: black, thin, in a topknot pinned with a wooden pin. Body: soft round shoulders, rounded back, a stoop from copying, short plump hands. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, wide sleeves tied back, a little rumpled; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; ink-stained cuffs. Hands and objects: a thin copying brush in the right hand and a small bamboo ink pot hanging from his belt; his left hand cups one ear; a stack of blank pale sheets under his arm; a low stool with a half-copied sheet of ruled lines (no letters). Background: tall dim shelves packed with identical lacquered boxes receding into shadow. Light: warm lamplight from the left with soft dust motes; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: diligent, trusting, content; unaware of what his cousin found.

people.imagined: Among the archive shelves at dusk she indexes letters with quick small hands and a smile that arrives half a second late. She is already composing next week's report to a man who does not deserve it.
people.subject: The moment: indexing a drawer of letters, her small quick fingers flick through slips, and when the viewer speaks she looks up and her smile comes half a second late, as if put on after a pause. Face: a small, narrow, pretty, neat face; bright quick dark eyes; thin well-shaped brows; a small straight nose; thin lips, the smile arriving late and a little too wide; fine lines at the eyes. Hair: black, in a neat coil at the back of the head with a flat iron pin. Body: small, thin, poised, quick; narrow shoulders; slender fingers. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, perfectly neat, narrow sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a plain pendant of dark wood on a cord. Hands and objects (the hands must read): very small, quick, pale hands with long thin fingers, mid-flick through a row of pale paper slips in a drawer; an open wooden cabinet of narrow drawers with small brass pulls behind her; a small slate with tally lines. Background: blurred archive cabinet wall, rows of drawers and a hanging lamp. Light: warm yellow light from the upper left and deep shadow beyond; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: ambitious, cautious, faithless; a smile on a delay.

people.imagined: At the writ office, bent over a fair copy of the spring's draft, chewing his lip as he writes. The corners of his pen-case are worn bare; he is thinking about how he will carry the page to the heir without being seen.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk he bends over a long sheet, brush in hand, his lower lip caught between his teeth, glancing up as if he heard a step. Face: a lean, earnest, sallow face; sharp dark eyes; thick straight brows drawn together; a straight nose; a thin mouth with the lower lip chewed red and slightly swollen; a short wispy moustache. Hair: black, tied in a topknot with an iron pin, a few strands stuck to his forehead. Body: thin, long-necked, hunched forward, one shoulder raised. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled back and tied; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; ink spots on the cuffs. Hands and objects: a brush in the right hand; on the desk a small wooden pen-case of dark lacquer whose corners are worn down to bare pale wood, clearly visible; a long sheet of pale paper ruled in columns (lines only, no letters) and a second identical sheet folded small under his sleeve. Background: blurred writ office with shelves of rolled documents, a hanging lamp. Light: warm light from a lamp at the left and cool daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: ambitious, loyal, impatient; a copyist with a secret errand.

people.imagined: On the seat's gate step in the rain, he has pulled a visitor aside for a search. His jaw grinds as if chewing iron and his cloak is stiff as board with rain. He picks who is searched by his temper.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a gate step in steady rain with his arms spread wide to block it, he glares at the viewer and his jaw works as if chewing iron. Face (most important: the working jaw): a heavy, square, weathered face with a massive jaw that bulges at the hinge as it chews; hard dark eyes under heavy dripping brows; a flat, broken nose; a thick downturned mouth; grey stubble beaded with rain. Hair: black and grey, cropped short, plastered flat by rain. Body: broad, solid, thick-necked, standing wide like a gate himself. Clothing: a cloak of undyed grey wool soaked so heavily that it stands stiff as board and drips, over a fine grey robe with a crossed collar and grey leather armour; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: both arms spread, the big hands open as if about to pat down the viewer; a long gate-keeper's staff with an iron-shod foot leaning at his shoulder. Background: a blurred wet stone gate arch with a lantern and sheets of rain. Light: grey rain light from the upper left, a wet shine on the stone and on his cloak; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: stubborn, warlike, arbitrary; he has chosen you.

people.imagined: On a long road at dusk, a plain brown scarf up to her eyes, she walks without any sign of tiredness while her heels bleed. Four sealed letters ride at her belt that no one has asked her to question.
people.subject: The moment: walking briskly along a road at dusk, a plain brown scarf pulled up over her nose and mouth so only her eyes show, she glances calmly at the viewer, not out of breath. Face: only the upper face is visible: calm, level, dark brown eyes with a cool steady gaze; thin straight brows; fine lines at the outer corners of the eyes; a tanned brow with a faint sheen of sweat. Hair: black, in a tight low knot, tucked under the scarf's edge. Body: lean, long-legged, light-footed, a walker's even stride, shoulders relaxed. Clothing: a fine undyed grey travelling robe, hem dusty, crossed collar, narrow sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; a plain brown scarf over the lower face. Her heels, visible above cloth shoes, are blistered and red. Hands and objects: a long leather satchel across the chest with a brass buckle; a walking staff in the left hand; four small rolled letters tied in cord, with blank wax seals, at her belt. Background: blurred long road between pines in violet dusk, a distant line of lights. Light: low violet-gold dusk light from the upper left; a faint blue-green water qi hint. Expression: ambitious, calm, deceitful; unhurried.

people.imagined: At the witness-house door on Compact day, whispering a line to the young judge who has lost his place. His face is a trodden loaf, his cloth the best in the house. He loses his salary at dice with a laugh.
people.subject: The moment: leaning in from a doorway to whisper urgently toward someone off to the side, one hand cupped at his mouth, a broad grin on his face. Face (most important: the trodden-loaf face and twice-broken nose): a wide, flat, lumpy face like a trodden loaf of bread; the nose is clearly broken twice, flattened and crooked, with two bumps; small merry black eyes buried in folds; bushy black brows; thick lips in a big gap-toothed grin; a scar through one eyebrow. Hair: black and grey, in a knot with a jade pin. Body: broad, heavy, a retired brawler's shoulders. Clothing: the finest cloth in the witness-house: a robe of heavy undyed grey silk with a crossed collar and a faint damask sheen, a seven-knot black cord at the waist with a small jade bead, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: the right hand cupped to his mouth, thick fingers; in the left a worn pair of dice; behind him a small shrine shelf holding a plain scroll-case. Background: blurred witness-house doorway with a carved lintel and a lamp. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: gregarious, just, indulgent; a prompter and a gambler.

people.imagined: At the mine office table in lamplight, ticking down a list with fast stubby fingers, putting the Metal children first. The lamp-scar on his chin catches the light. He has struck a name off for correcting his sums.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk by lamplight, his stubby fingers tick down a long list with a brush, quick as a woodpecker, and he glances up with an impatient shrug. Face: a stubbly, round, sallow face; small, sharp, bloodshot black eyes; thick arched brows; a flat short nose; a thin mouth with a pragmatic twist; a pale crescent-shaped scar on the chin from a mine-lamp. Hair: black, greasy, cropped, with a leather band. Body: short, stocky, heavy-set, hunched over the desk. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, soiled at the cuffs with black iron dust, crossed collar, sleeves pushed up; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the fingers must read): very short, stubby, fast fingers with square tips moving down a long list of pale ruled columns (lines only, no letters), the brush held between thumb and two fingers; a brass mine lamp with a small flame hanging at the corner of the desk; a pile of small round tokens in two groups. Background: blurred dark mine office with timber props and a hanging pick. Light: warm lamplight from the lower left and a cool shadow above; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: pragmatic, arbitrary, diligent; tidy and unfair.

people.imagined: At the striking bench in the mint she counts blank discs with her lips, and counts again. A silver-blue bruise darkens her thumbnail and she keeps looking at the die-man across the room.
people.subject: The moment: at a mint bench she counts a stack of blank silver discs with her fingertip, lips moving, then looks up suspiciously across the room toward the viewer. Face: a narrow, pale, sharp, careful face; keen light-brown eyes that count what they see; thin level brows; a thin straight nose; pursed lips moving in a count; a faint line between the brows. Hair: black, in a tight knot under a grey cloth cap. Body: thin, wiry, strong forearms, shoulders slightly raised. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled and cuffed in leather; a heavy leather apron; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. Hands and objects (the thumbnail must read): the nail of the right thumb is a clear, dark silver-blue bruise, as if stained with metal, plainly visible; on the bench two exact stacks of blank silver discs, a small hammer and an iron die; a coil of cord on a hook. Background: blurred mint with a glowing furnace and a second striker out of focus. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower left, cold window light from above; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: paranoid, honest, diligent; counting everything twice.

people.imagined: At the pill market, he clears his throat before writing the weighing into the book in front of the buyer, blue chalk on his cuffs, and demands that the standard weights be weighed against one another.
people.subject: The moment: at a market counter he clears his throat with a fist at his mouth before bending to write in a large ledger, glancing up with a stubborn, precise look. Face: a thin, neat, fussy face; precise, pale-grey eyes; thin straight brows; a narrow nose; a small, firm mouth held around the cough; a close-trimmed black moustache. A small tidy furrow sits between his brows. Hair: black, parted, in a tidy knot with a wooden pin. Body: tall, narrow, a clerk's straight back, hands folded. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, perfectly pressed, narrow sleeves with the cuffs smudged with BLUE chalk, clearly visible as bright bands; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a brush in the right hand and a thick ledger with ruled columns of tick marks (no letters) open on the counter; a set of small bronze weights in a row and a brass balance. Background: blurred market stalls with rows of small ceramic pill jars and customers. Awnings of undyed cloth shade the stalls and the jars on the shelves are neatly stacked. Light: bright even daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a precise, stubborn, closed frown, lips tight around a cough, the scrupulous look of a man who will weigh the weights against each other if you let him.

people.imagined: At the quarry she stands beside a freshly cut blank for a stele, resting a palm on its face, with quarry grit under the skin of her palms. Three of the 129 standing stones are her work, and she laughs, slowly and deeply.
people.subject: The moment: beside a smooth new slab of grey stone she rests one palm on its face and laughs a slow, deep laugh with her head tipped back a little. Face: a broad, strong, weathered, kind face; deep laugh lines; small warm brown eyes crinkled shut; thick straight brows; a broad nose; a wide mouth open in a rumbling laugh; stone dust on the brows. Hair: black with grey, in a thick plait coiled round the head and tied with a leather thong. Body: tall, broad, powerful, a stone-cutter's thick shoulders and arms. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, heavily dusted pale at the sleeves and knees, sleeves rolled; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar; a leather apron. Hands and objects (the grit must read): the palms and the pads of the fingers are ground with fine grey quarry grit into the skin, like sandpaper, a dull grey tone on the hand laid on the stone; a steel wedge and a heavy mallet at her feet; behind her a stack of identical new slabs of grey stone. Background: blurred open quarry with sheer pale cut walls and a derrick. Light: bright clear daylight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: patient, humble, stubborn; slow, deep merriment.

people.imagined: On the harbour scales, jingling a ring of keys as he writes a fine. The salt has split his lips. He weighed the basket himself and still fined the pearl boat a season's catch.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour quay he jingles a big ring of keys in one hand, mid-gesture, and looks smugly at the viewer while pointing to a crate on the scales. Face (most important: the salt-split lips): a lean, tanned, smirking face; his lips are visibly cracked and split by salt, with red fissures and white dried flakes, clearly shown; sly dark eyes; thin arched brows; a pointed nose; a thin goatee. Hair: black, tied in a knot with a blue sea-cloth. Body: thin, tall, a wiry harbour official's stance, weight on one leg. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled, a short dark sea-blue jerkin over it; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a heavy iron ring bearing about a dozen keys of varied sizes, jingling; a big brass counterweight scale with a crate on one pan; at his belt a small purse. Background: blurred harbour with masts, ropes, crates and a pale sea. Light: bright salt-bright light from the upper left, a glint off the brass; a faint blue water qi hint. Expression: greedy, gregarious, pragmatic; a man who fines the difference.

people.imagined: At the watch post at dusk, he has already written the whole night's line in the watch book and yawns, hair crumpled from his nap, pencil chewed to splinters. He is going to bed.
people.subject: The moment: at a small desk at dusk he yawns hugely, one hand over his mouth and the other holding a chewed pencil, a bed visible behind. Face: a young-looking, round, sleepy face; heavy-lidded brown eyes half-shut; thick dark brows; a short wide nose; a mouth open in a huge yawn; faint pillow-creases on one cheek. A faint stubble shadows his chin. Hair (most important: sleep-crumpled): black hair crushed flat on one side and spiked on the other as if just woken, with a cowlick at the crown. Body: lanky, loose, slouched, a lazy lean on one elbow. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, rumpled, the collar crossed crookedly, sleeves loose; a black cord with seven knots at the waist, half untied; no star. Hands and objects: a pencil of lead chewed to splinters, the end splintered into a brush of wood fibres, clearly visible; a thick watch book open to rows of tidy tick marks (no letters); a folded blanket and a lamp. Background: blurred watch-post room with a window showing a dusk sky and snow. A thin blanket is folded on the cot and snow ticks against the window. Light: warm lamplight from the left and cold blue dusk through the window; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a vast, heavy-lidded yawn with eyes swimming and a trusting slackness, the cheerful certainty of a man who wrote the night quiet and is going to bed.

people.imagined: On the miasma line at dusk with her hood up, a smoke-grey cloak, her stare so hard sentries look away. She will not hear one man's name said kindly.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a low rise in pale dusk haze with the hood of a smoke-grey cloak up, she stares straight at the viewer with an unblinking, hard look. Face (most important: the stare): a pale, angular, severe face half in hood shadow; very pale grey eyes fixed and unblinking, rimmed with dark shadow; thin black straight brows; a sharp nose; a thin, bloodless, set mouth; high cheekbones. Hair: black, mostly hidden under the hood, a single lock escaping at the cheek. Body: tall, straight, thin and hard, standing like a post. Clothing: a long smoke-grey wool cloak with the hood up, over a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and grey armour at the chest; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a long spear planted in the ground in the right hand, the left holding a small shuttered lantern; her gloved knuckles are white on the haft. Background: blurred pale mist rolling over a dark plain with a faint distant grave mound. Light: dim grey dusk light from the upper left and a thin yellow lantern glow from below; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: loyal, vengeful, brave; she does not forgive.

people.imagined: In the roll room, he smooths a page with his thumb before turning it, counting the elders who will back his master, and keeps the count in no book. His face is forgettable and he cultivates that.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk he smooths a page with his thumb before turning it, and looks up with a bland, pleasant, utterly forgettable expression. Face (most important: smooth, forgettable): an even, smooth, mild face, neither handsome nor plain; calm brown eyes; level thin brows; a straight, average nose; a small polite smile; no mark, no scar. His skin is clean and unmarked and his ears sit neat against his head. Hair: neat black, parted in the middle and tied in a small tidy knot with a plain wooden pin. Body: medium height, medium build, soft shoulders, hands folded neatly. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, spotless and exactly pressed, narrow sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. Hands and objects: the right thumb smoothing the edge of a heavy page of a big roll book (ruled columns of tick marks, no letters); a row of identical small cloth-bound roll books on the desk in perfect alignment; a plain brush laid straight on a rest. His hands are pale, clean, and finished at the nails, not a mark of ink on them. Background: blurred roll room with shelves of identical rolls and a lamp. Light: even soft grey light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a bland, pleasant, utterly forgettable face with a small polite smile, the placid look of a man keeping a count nobody has seen.

people.imagined: In the outer gate yard she lets out a bellow that carries across the whole gate to call her brother, her yak-wool braids swinging, a yak calf at her heels.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone yard she cups both hands round her mouth and bellows across the gate, mouth wide, chest lifted, with a yak calf standing at her side. Face: a broad, ruddy, high-cheekboned young face with wind-reddened cheeks; bright black eyes narrowed in effort; strong straight brows; a short nose; a huge open mouth. A fine layer of wind-burn peels at the tip of her nose and a pale scar crosses her chin. Hair: black, in two long thick braids wound with brown yak-wool, swinging at her shoulders. Body: stocky, big-shouldered, strong thighs. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, short sleeves, no cord or star, over which a sleeveless yak-wool vest of brown and cream; a heavy leather belt. Wool tassels in red and ochre hang from the ends of both braids and a horn button fastens the vest. Hands and objects: both hands cupped at the mouth; a shaggy black-and-white yak calf with stubby horns standing close beside her, a milk pail at her feet. Background: blurred stone gate yard, a weight rack, small figures turning to look. A yak-hair tent and a line of drying cheese on a rack show beyond the wall. Light: bright mountain light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: brave, impatient, generous; heard to the far wall.

people.imagined: After the great scale at the solstice, he sits on the step with a heavy pout, watching the Metal pan rise in his memory. He loves the woman who would not tip it.
people.subject: The moment: sitting heavily on a stone step with elbows on his knees and a deep pout, he looks up at the viewer with wounded, hopeful eyes. Face: a broad, heavy, round young face with a pronounced stubborn pout, the lower lip thrust out; sad dark brown eyes; thick low brows; a flat wide nose; a small cleft in the chin; sunburnt cheeks. Hair: black, cropped short and bristly. A few damp bristles stick up at the crown and a small speck of pale dust lies on his eyebrow. Body: heavy-shouldered, thick-necked, large, slumped, big knees. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, short sleeves, no cord or star; a thick leather belt; sturdy herder's boots. Hands and objects: big hands hanging between his knees, one holding a small grey pebble; behind him a great bronze balance with two pans, one raised high and one low. Background: blurred stone gate yard with a large scale on a frame and a few disciples. Light: flat grey light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. The bronze of the scale gives a dull gold edge to the light on his cheek. Expression: stubborn, diligent, humble; sulking but loyal. He sulks with his eyes wet and bright, as if he might at once forgive and be forgiven.

people.imagined: At the rice pot he is first in line, grinning a beat after the joke is over, his felt cap pulled low, having lost his month's rations to a bet. He forgives everyone.
people.subject: The moment: queuing with an empty bowl held out, he breaks into a delayed grin a full beat after everyone else has finished laughing. Face: a round, freckled, cheerful young face; small bright dark eyes half hidden by a low cap; thin brows; a pug nose; a wide late grin; one crooked front tooth. His cheeks are rosy with cold and a few stray freckles cluster at the bridge of the nose. Hair: black, tufts escaping the cap at the ears. Body: short, stocky, easy shoulders, a bounce in the stance. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, short sleeves, no cord or star; a round white felt cap pulled down low over the brows, the nomad kind, clean and pressed; a yurt-maker's felt belt of red and brown. Hands and objects: an empty wooden bowl held out in both hands; a ladle and a steaming rice pot at the edge of the frame; a bit of felt twine looped at the belt. Background: blurred dining yard, benches, a smoky kitchen door. Steam from the rice pot rises in a white veil behind him, and a few boys wait with bowls in the queue. Light: warm steam-hazy light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: gregarious, lazy, forgiving; grinning late.

people.imagined: In the outer gate yard at midday she holds up a small stone weight for a younger girl to feel, patient, her great-uncle's long-lidded eyes warm. She has already decided to stay and teach.
people.subject: The moment: crouching in a stone yard she places a smooth round grey weight in the open palms of a small girl, only the child's hands and sleeve entering the frame, while looking up kindly at the viewer. Face: a gentle, oval, pale-brown face; long-lidded, slightly drooping, warm brown eyes just like an old man's; soft level brows; a small, straight nose; a calm, patient smile; a mole under the left eye. Hair: black, in a neat low bun held by one plain wooden pin, with a single loose strand behind the ear. Body: slender, medium height, kneeling with the back straight, a steady teacher's posture. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, clean and neatly mended at the elbows with matching thread; short sleeves rolled once; no cord, no star; a folded cloth tied at the waist; cloth shoes. Hands and objects: both hands steady around a round grey stone weight the size of a melon, laid in the child's hands; beside her on the stones a row of weights from small to large; a small clay water jar. Background: blurred yard with a long weight rack, a pale wall, a few other disciples. Light: soft clear midday light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: compassionate, patient, honest; teaching without hurry.

people.imagined: On the high slope with the goats, his lips pressed tight over a tune he will not whistle, one hand going to his mouth and stopping. A kid nibbles at his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: on a rocky slope with a small flock of goats around him he stands with his lips pressed shut so tightly they whiten, one finger half-raised to his mouth as if to stop a whistle. Face: a lean, tanned, quiet face; large soft brown eyes with a faraway look; thin straight brows; a narrow nose; the mouth clamped flat and pale, the cheeks slightly hollowed with effort. Hair: black, tousled, tied with a bit of string; two or three tufts of goat hair stuck in it. Body: tall, loose, thin, a herder's slow stoop and long legs. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, short sleeves, no cord or star; the sleeves are packed with goat hair, white and brown tufts poking from the cuffs and clinging to the cloth, clearly visible; a goat-hide vest; rope sandals. Hands and objects: a long herder's crook in the left hand; a brown and white kid nibbling the right sleeve; a few more goats of grey and cream on the rocks behind him. Background: a blurred rocky mountain slope under a wide pale sky, a thin path winding. Light: clean bright morning light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: reclusive, content, peaceable; keeping a song inside.

people.imagined: In the courtyard she counts coins into her sleeve-purse with a sharp little smile while a boy at her side tries to bargain. She has the rice debt in her head to the grain.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a yard she tucks a handful of copper coins into a small purse sewn into her sleeve, eyes sharp and sparkling, lips curved in a keen little smile. Face (most important: the sharp little chin): a small, heart-shaped face with a notably sharp, pointed little chin; bright quick dark eyes; neat arched brows; a small straight nose; a thin, clever, smiling mouth; pink cheeks. A trace of rouge-pink warms each cheekbone. Hair: black, in a tight high ponytail with a red string, the tail bobbing. Body: small, quick, narrow shoulders, upright and brisk. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, no cord or star; the left sleeve is turned back to show an inner pocket neatly sewn into it, a small round cloth purse, clearly visible and bulging; cloth shoes. Hands and objects: the right hand dropping a coin into the sleeve purse; the left hand holding a small slate with neat rows of chalk tally strokes; behind her, a cousin, blurred, holding a wine-skin. Background: blurred courtyard with a rice-pot and benches. Light: bright daylight from the upper left, a glint on the coin; a faint ochre earth qi hint. A hard sun spark winks on the coin as it falls. Expression: a bright, brisk, sharp-eyed little smile, lips curved and chin pointed, the satisfied face of a girl collecting what she is owed.

people.imagined: At the great scale in winter he climbs up with a lead strip sewn into the coat his friend holds, and stares, sleepless, at the Metal pan that never rises. His bone thumb-ring is the second; the first went down a well.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the foot of a large bronze scale he turns and stares at the viewer with a sleepless, bloodshot, watchful stare. Face: a hard, narrow, tanned, hungry face; wide dark eyes ringed with dark shadow and red at the rims; thin straight brows; a thin hooked nose; a thin mouth with a faint smirk of calculation; a few thin hairs on the lip. Hair: black, long, braided in a single thin queue down the back and a short fringe. Body: lean, wiry, stooped, tense, ready to climb. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and short sleeves, no cord or star; an ordinary nomad felt vest; at the hem of the robe a heavy-looking stitched seam. Hands and objects: on the right thumb a carved bone thumb-ring, a pale curved band, clearly visible; the left hand holds a folded coat out to the side, on which a small grey lead strip is visibly sewn along the lining; a large bronze scale with two pans, one raised, one low, behind him. Background: blurred winter yard with frost on stones, a girl in nomad braids in the distance. Light: cold pale morning light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: ambitious, deceitful, paranoid; always one trick away.

people.imagined: On a terrace she lays one more dry-stone course, fitting a stone she has turned in her hands three times. The plait round her head is like a rope; she has no wish to pass the beam.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at the top of a half-built dry-stone wall she settles a rough grey stone into its place with a satisfied little tap of her knuckle. Face: a calm, round, sun-browned face; steady dark eyes watching the stone; level, thick brows; a short nose with a smear of dust; a small, content smile. Hair (most important: the rope-plait): black hair in one very thick plait wound round her head like a coil of rope, held by a plain iron pin, plainly visible as a thick braided crown. Body: sturdy, broad-shouldered, strong forearms, kneeling with weight low. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and short sleeves rolled up, no cord or star; a leather kneepad strapped on each knee; a cloth tied round the waist. Hands and objects: the knuckles of both hands are nicked and scabbed with small pale scars, clearly visible; the right hand tapping a stone; a plumb line with a stone bob hanging from the wall; a pile of sorted stones. Background: blurred terraces climbing a hillside, a section of tidy grey wall and a pale sky. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: calm, diligent, temperate; no wish to be anywhere else.

people.imagined: On a plateau slope at morning he digs a milkvetch root with a small spade and holds it up, brown earth to the elbows. He is paid in pill dust and gives most of it away.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling on a grassy slope he holds up a long pale milkvetch root from the earth, a shy, pleased smile on his face. Face: a mild, thin, brown face; big gentle dark eyes; soft thin brows; a straight nose; a small shy smile; a smudge of earth on the chin. His cheeks are sunburnt and a few freckles show on his nose. Hair: brown, short and unkempt, a bit of dry grass in it. Body: slim, a little stooped, soft hands. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled to the elbow, no cord or star; the knees of the trousers are earth-stained; a cloth bag on a strap across the chest. Hands and objects (the stained fingers must read): the fingers and nails of both hands are stained dark brown with root juice and earth, clearly visible; a long, pale, branching root in the right hand; a small wooden spade stuck in the ground; a basket of more roots with leaves at his knee. Background: blurred wide plateau slope with dry yellow grass, a few small flowers and distant peaks. Light: clear morning light from the upper left; a faint green wood qi and ochre earth qi hint. The thin morning sun lights the pale root like a lamp. Expression: a shy, glad, gentle smile with soft eyes, the humble pleasure of a young man who gives most of what he digs away.

people.imagined: In the kitchen she is churning butter tea in a tall wooden churn, laughing so the churn seems to ring, a smear of butter on her sleeve. She is impatient to learn the weights with the churn.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a tall wooden butter-tea churn, she plunges the dasher up and down with both hands, laughing out loud with her head thrown back. Face: a bright, round, rosy young face; sparkling black eyes half shut in laughter; thin arched brows; a small round nose; a wide open laughing mouth showing a missing side tooth. Her cheeks are round and shining with steam. Hair: black, in two short pigtails tied with scraps of white cloth, bouncing. A few damp wisps cling to her forehead. Body: small, sturdy, young, energetic, up on her toes. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and sleeves pushed up, no cord or star; a long apron of undyed linen splashed with pale butter; the left sleeve has a shiny smear of yellow butter from wrist to elbow, clearly visible; wool socks and clogs. Hands and objects: both hands on the dasher of a tall, banded, dark-wood churn; a pale foamy tea line at the churn's lip; a steaming kettle and a stack of clay bowls on the table. Background: blurred warm kitchen with a hearth, hanging pots and steam. Light: warm firelight from the lower left and soft steam haze; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a loud, bright, trusting laugh with the head thrown back and the whole face open, a girl who laughs like a bell and is itching to learn the weights.

people.imagined: At night by the great scale, spear-butt on the frost, red-rimmed night-guard eyes fixed. He tied a boy to the rack in the cold and he is still watching for the next one.
people.subject: The moment: standing guard at night beside a great bronze scale on a frosty stone ground, he stares unblinking at the viewer, spear planted. Face (most important: red-rimmed eyes): a hard, pale, square face; deep-set dark eyes with raw, red, swollen rims from sleepless nights; thick straight black brows; a broad nose with a white frost on the tip; a thick, flat, cruel mouth; a stubbled jaw. Hair: black, cropped, under a grey wool cap pulled low. Body: broad, heavy, tall; planted square with shoulders hunched against cold. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves tight; a heavy sheepskin coat in cream-grey over it; no cord or star; wrapped leggings. Hands and objects: a long spear with an iron head, the butt planted on the frost, held in the right hand, on whose palm a hard yellow callus is visible; a small shuttered lantern at his belt; a coil of rope hanging on the rack beside him. Background: blurred night yard with the great scale's frame, a white frost on the stones, a few stars. Light: cold blue moonlight from the upper left and a small yellow lantern from below; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: brave, callous, stubborn; watching for the next thief.

people.imagined: On the Thạch Kiều road at a run, mud to the knees though the weather has been dry, thin calves flashing, a letter in her fist. Her brother is betting on her time.
people.subject: The moment: running hard along a road, one foot airborne, a rolled letter gripped in her fist, her face set and focused. Face: a thin, hard-working, tanned face; steady dark eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, determined mouth; a line of sweat on the temple. Her cheeks are flushed with effort and a wisp of hair clings to her neck. Hair: black, in a tight plait pinned up at the nape, a little loose. Body: lean, long-legged, light, with the thin calves of a runner and long strides. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe hitched up and tucked into the belt above the knees, crossed collar, short sleeves, no cord or star; both legs are caked in mud to the knee, clearly visible even on a dry road; cloth running shoes tied tight. Hands and objects: a small rolled letter with a blank wax seal in the right fist; a flat leather pouch bouncing at her hip; a small bone whistle on a cord. Background: blurred dry dusty road with roadside pines and a distant bridge. Long shadows of pine trunks stripe the dry road and a puff of dust rises behind her heel. Light: bright daylight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a set, honest, narrow-eyed determination, lips closed and brow level, a runner thinking only of the road and not of her brother's wager.

people.imagined: On the Bridge Court steps he cannot keep his heels still, selling a whisper for a cake. His left sleeve is torn and tied with string; he looks round to see who has seen.
people.subject: The moment: perched on a stone step he drums his heels restlessly and leans close, one hand cupped to whisper, eyes darting sideways at the viewer. Face: a thin, quick, street-bred face; bright darting dark eyes; thin arched brows; a pointed nose; a mobile mouth caught in a half-grin; a small scar through the left eyebrow. A smudge of sweet rice flour dusts his upper lip. Hair: black, messy, tied up with a bit of cord, a few tufts sticking out. Body: wiry, small, restless, heels bouncing. His shoulders hunch conspiratorially as he leans forward. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe of plain but clean cloth, crossed collar, no cord or star; the left sleeve is ripped at the shoulder and tied back with a bit of twine, plainly visible, a street boy's habit he has never bothered to break; a flat leather messenger pouch slung across the chest; cloth shoes with a split toe. Hands and objects: a rolled summons tied with a grey cord held in the left hand; the right hand cupped to the mouth; half a sweet rice cake in the pocket. Background: blurred wide stone steps of the Bridge Court, a crowd of listeners sitting, a pillar. Light: bright daylight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a quick, mobile, cheeky half-grin with bright darting eyes, the look of a boy who has just sold a whisper for a cake and is checking who saw.

people.imagined: At the seat gate in late afternoon, standing guard with a long solemn face while a puppy chews his bootlace; he does not move because his captain is watching.
people.subject: The moment: standing very stiff at a gate post, face solemn and eyes front, while a fat grey-and-white puppy gnaws at his bootlace down below. Face (most important: the long solemn face): a long, narrow, mournful, earnest face like a horse; sad, honest brown eyes; thick straight brows; a long straight nose; a long upper lip; a closed, serious mouth. Faint sunburn tints his long nose and a bead of sweat runs from his temple. Hair: brown, cropped short, under a plain grey cap. Body: tall, thin, upright, standing at attention with a rigid back. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and tight sleeves, over grey leather armour; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; his bootlaces are chewed into fuzz, clearly visible, one trailing on the ground. Hands and objects: a long spear held upright in both hands, knuckles pale; at his feet a plump puppy of a shaggy grey sheepdog tugging the lace; a small tin cup on a hook at his belt. The spear's shaft is smooth and dark with the grip of his two hands. Background: blurred massive stone gate with a grey banner (no marks), a lamp. Light: warm late-afternoon light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a long, solemn, helpless gravity, eyes front and mouth shut tight, a loyal sentry who dare not look down.

people.imagined: In the practice yard with a training spear, a jaw twitching when someone says the word peace. He laughed when a boy was gored in practice and called it footwork.
people.subject: The moment: in a practice yard he leans on a training spear with one hip cocked, and his jaw twitches visibly as if someone had said a hated word. Face (most important: the twitching jaw): a lean, hard, hollow-cheeked young face; a muscle clearly bunched and jumping along the jaw hinge; narrow, cold dark eyes; thin black brows; a hooked nose; a thin sneering mouth. A thin pale scar nicks his upper lip. Hair: black, in a tight topknot with an iron pin. Body: tall, lean, sinewy, a hard-trained spearman's build, forearms cabled with muscle. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled to the elbow to show lean forearms; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; grey leather bracers. Hands and objects: a long training spear with a blunt wooden head and a grey tassel in the right hand; the left hand fist clenched on the hip; a rack of identical training spears behind him. Background: blurred practice yard with straw targets and a rack. Straw targets stand pierced and shredded in a row and a pale dust hangs in the air. Light: hard bright light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a cold, sneering, hungry stare with the jaw jumping, a man who wants the war more than anyone else in the yard and does not trouble to hide it.

people.imagined: At the mint filing blanks in a slow even rhythm, silver filings glinting in her eyelashes, taking a careful measured step across the floor. She counts the blanks a third time.
people.subject: The moment: at a filing bench she holds up a blank silver disc between finger and thumb and checks it against the light, silver dust sparkling on her lashes. Face (most important: silver filings in the eyelashes): a calm, carefully composed, oval face; honest grey eyes with a fringe of eyelashes sparkling with fine silver dust, clearly glinting; neat level brows; a straight nose; a small tidy mouth. Hair: black, parted and pinned in a low bun under a grey cloth cap. Body: slender, upright, controlled, an even measured way of standing. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled and cuffed in leather; a heavy leather apron; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. Hands and objects: a thin silver disc held up in the right hand; a flat steel file in the left; on the bench three stacks of blank discs and a small brass counting dish; silver filings in a thin glittering layer on the bench edge. Background: blurred mint workshop with a dull furnace glow and the shape of a second worker. Light: cool bright light from the upper left, with silver glints; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: cautious, diligent, honest; counting a third time.

people.imagined: Back at the mine shaft after passing the beam and being sent home, he sits on a ward-stone with a curved back and a serene look, entirely unbothered.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a squat grey ward-stone at a mine mouth, his back deeply curved, he looks up with a serene, unhurried look. Face: a broad, placid, brown young face; calm, slow dark eyes; thick relaxed brows; a flat wide nose; a gentle half-smile; a dusting of black iron grit on the cheek. Fine black dust lies in his eyelashes. Hair: black, short, plain. Body: broad, thick through the back, with a pronounced curve of the spine from mine work, hands resting on the knees. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, dust-black at the hem and cuffs; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; heavy mining boots. Hands and objects: a small hammer and a flat grey ward-stone with a faint cut ring pattern (no letters) beside him; the right hand holds a miner's lantern with a calm flame; the left on his knee. The lantern glass is clean and the wick burns steady. Background: blurred mine entrance with timber props and rails; a cart with a single black ingot. Light: warm lantern light from the lower left and cold daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a serene, slow, placid half-smile, the unbothered calm of a man who was sent home and is entirely at home where he was sent.

people.imagined: On the night of the new moon she scrubs the soot from an array node, a pilgrim's bead string running through her thumbs as she works, her palms grey. She is learning the order of the seven.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling beside a low round bronze node plate she scrubs it with a stiff brush, a string of dark wooden prayer beads looped round her left thumb clicking over as she works. Face: a calm, pale, oval face; downcast steady dark eyes; fine level brows; a straight nose; a small peaceful mouth; a smear of soot on the cheek. Hair: black, in a long single braid pinned up in a round coil, a few wisps loose. Body: slim, kneeling very straight, her sleeves tied back. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and narrow sleeves, tied back; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; cloth shoes folded under her. Hands and objects (the grey palms must read): both palms and fingers are stained soot-grey, a dull dark grey like pencil lead, clearly visible; a pilgrim's bead string of dark wood in the left hand; a stiff scrubbing brush in the right and a pail of water; the round bronze node plate with a faintly raised ring pattern (no letters). Background: blurred dim array chamber with six other node plates in a curved row, faint candles. Light: soft candlelight from the lower left and pale light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: patient, calm, devout; counting beads and nodes.

people.imagined: In the guardhouse he has checked the wall behind him before sitting, and sits now with his eyes on the door, thumbnails cracked from digging snow-jade. He suspects the evening watch is worse than grief.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a bench with his back pressed against a wall, he watches the doorway with narrowed eyes, one hand resting on the hilt of a short sword. Face: a lean, pale, drawn face; restless dark eyes ringed with shadow, constantly watching; thin straight brows; a sharp nose; a thin tight mouth; a few days of dark stubble. Hair: black, tied in a short knot, sweat-damp. Body: wiry, tense, sitting upright on the front edge of the bench with his feet planted ready to rise. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, sleeves tight and bound; grey leather armour over the chest; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; fur-lined boots. Hands and objects (the thumbnails must read): the thumbnails on both hands are cracked, split and ridged, with dark grime in the splits, clearly visible; the right hand on the hilt of a short sword in a worn scabbard; a lit lantern on the bench. Background: blurred guardhouse stone wall with a barred window showing snow. Light: low warm lantern light from the left and cold blue window light; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: paranoid, loyal, brave; trusting only the wall behind him.

people.imagined: At the copying desk with cramped shoulders, a hair-ribbon the colour of pine soot, forming a careful stroke. She has been told never to ask for the Chiết Kích shelf and does not know why.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a desk with her shoulders drawn up in a cramped hunch she forms a careful brush stroke on a sheet, tongue between her teeth, then glances up. Face: a plain, earnest, round young face; mild brown eyes; soft level brows; a small nose; her tongue tip between her teeth in concentration; a tiny ink dot on the cheek. Hair: black, in a long braid tied with a dark ribbon the colour of pine soot, matt black-green, clearly visible. Body: small, cramped round-shouldered copyist's frame, shoulders raised nearly to her ears. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, wide sleeves tied back; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; cuffs stained with black ink. Hands and objects: a thin brush in the right hand and a small stone ink-slab with fresh black ink; a half-copied sheet of ruled columns of tick marks (no letters); a model sheet pinned at the top; a small jar of village-made ink with a plain cork. Background: blurred archive copying room with shelves and a narrow window. Light: soft grey daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: diligent, trusting, humble; innocent of the forbidden shelf.

people.imagined: At the standard scales, fingers hovering over a weight as if reading it, chin cocked, declaring that someone's weights are light, louder than he should. He has chosen a merchant to dislike today.
people.subject: The moment: at a weighing counter he holds one hand hovering above a small bronze weight as if reading it with the skin, chin tilted cockily up, and looks at the viewer with arrogant certainty. Face: a sharp-featured, handsome young face; confident dark eyes; thick arched brows; a straight nose; a smug smile on a stubborn mouth; a narrow chin held high. Hair: black, glossy, in a neat knot with a wooden pin. Body: lean, upright, a swaggering lean back, shoulders thrown wide. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, well cut, narrow sleeves with the cuffs buttoned; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. Hands and objects (the hovering fingers must read): the long fingers of the right hand are spread and hover a finger-width above the weight, not touching it, clearly poised; on the counter a row of small bronze weights and a brass balance; the left hand pointing accusingly at one of the pans. Background: blurred market stall, merchants' baskets, a pill-stall awning in the distance. Light: bright daylight from the upper left, glints on the bronze; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: arbitrary, stubborn, arrogant; always right today.

people.imagined: At the quarry she swings a mallet, one arm bulged with muscle, rock-flour in her hair, impatient to plant a stele on the border instead of cutting it. She looks up, daring someone to tell her to wait.
people.subject: The moment: at a quarry face she swings a heavy iron mallet over her shoulder mid-blow, her whole body twisted into the stroke, and glares at the viewer with a challenge. Face: a strong, broad, freckled, determined face; bright hazel eyes narrowed; thick straight brows; a snub nose; a stubborn, set jaw and a tight mouth. Hair: brown, tied in a thick tail, plastered pale with rock-flour so that it looks powdered grey, clearly visible. Body: tough, stocky, one forearm visibly bulged from the mallet, broad back. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and sleeves cut short at the elbow, heavily dusted with pale stone powder; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; a leather apron and strap-on gloves. Hands and objects: a heavy iron mallet in the right hand; a steel wedge held in the left against a stone face; behind her a stack of rough-cut slabs; chips of grey stone in the air. Background: blurred open quarry face with a pale, sheer cliff and a derrick. Light: bright harsh light from the upper left and a white haze of stone dust; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: impatient, ambitious, brave; anxious to put the stone where it stands.

people.imagined: In the open square at Song Kiều he rubs an ore sample on the touchstone and shouts the grade, his voice cracking. Thin scars of silver thread cross his fingertips.
people.subject: The moment: in an open square he rubs a lump of ore across a black touchstone held in his left hand and calls out a grade, mouth wide, his voice visibly cracking. Face: a thin, honest, eager young face; bright brown eyes wide with effort; thin straight brows; a pointed nose; an open mouth shouting, the throat bobbing; a few pimples on the chin. Hair: black, short and spiky, with a bit of cloth tied round the brow. Body: thin, gangly, adolescent, a prominent Adam's apple. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled to the elbow; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star; a leather apron. Hands and objects (the scars must read): the fingertips of both hands are crossed with many fine pale thread-like scars, shining faintly silver, clearly visible; the black touchstone with a bright streak of silver rubbed on it; a lump of grey ore in the right hand; a basket of ore at his feet. Background: blurred open square with miners, carts, brass scales and an old merchant listening closely. Light: bright morning light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: honest, gregarious, diligent; shouting so the rival assayers hear.

people.imagined: In the seat kitchen at the height of the noon rush, she jabs her ladle like a spear at a steward who has come to count the stores. She has been shouting for forty years and enjoys it.
people.subject: The moment: in a smoky kitchen she thrusts a long iron ladle forward like a spear, pointed straight at the viewer, her mouth open mid-shout. Face: a broad, ruddy, strong-featured woman's face, shiny with heat; blazing dark eyes; thick straight brows drawn down; a short broad nose; a wide mouth open in a shout, strong square teeth; a sheen of sweat. Hair: black going grey, tied in a thick knot under a white cloth. Body: short, broad, powerful, a cook's strong shoulders and round middle, planted wide. Clothing: a servant's tunic of plain undyed grey hemp, clean and heavy, a crossed collar, short sleeves; a long linen apron stained with butter and flour; no cord or star. Hands and objects (the scald must read): her LEFT forearm, bared to the elbow, carries a broad shiny pink-red scald scar, glossy and puckered, plainly visible beside the ladle; the long iron ladle gripped in her right hand; a great black iron pot steaming behind her, hanging mutton joints and strings of dried barley sheaves. Background: blurred busy kitchen with a hearth fire, copper pots and steam. Light: strong orange firelight from the lower left and steam haze; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: generous, wrathful, diligent; her kitchen, her law.

people.imagined: At dusk in the clock-house, he stands perfectly still beside the water clock with the bell-rope in his hand, waiting the last drop before the one stroke. The clock-hands seem nervous beside him.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk he stands utterly still beside a stone water-clock, one hand on a bell-rope, eyes fixed on a single falling drop. Face (most important: the stillness): a smooth, long, calm face with no tension anywhere; deep-set steady brown eyes that do not blink; level brows; a straight nose; a closed, peaceful mouth; a face like still water. Hair: black, short, tied with a plain cord. Body: tall, lean, balanced, without motion; long patient forearms hanging relaxed. Clothing: a servant's tunic of plain undyed grey hemp, neat and clean, a crossed collar, sleeves rolled to show long forearms; no cord or star; a leather apron; bare calves. Hands and objects: the right hand lightly on a thick bell-rope that rises out of frame to a single bronze bell; before him a tall stone water-clock of stepped basins, a single drop of water hanging from a spout; a small bronze marker on a rail. Background: blurred round clock-house with a dim bronze bell above and the last gold light in a window. Light: soft, low, golden dusk light from the upper left on the water; a faint blue water qi hint. Expression: patient, devout, reclusive; the bell will be struck once and never twice.

people.imagined: In the archive's ink room, he has licked the grinding stone again and his lips are blue. He edges sideways along a shelf with a feather duster, shy, and looks up when the copyist points.
people.subject: The moment: shuffling sideways along a shelf with a feather duster in one hand, he glances shyly at the viewer, lips stained blue. Face (most important: the ink-blue lips): a soft, plain, boyish face; both lips are stained a vivid dark ink-blue, as if painted, clearly visible; shy, round, brown eyes; thin soft brows; a short snub nose; a small timid smile; blue on the tongue tip. His ears are pink with embarrassment. Hair: black, cut short, a cowlick at the back. Body: slight, narrow-shouldered, a shy crabwise sideways gait with the shoulder pointed ahead. Clothing: a servant's tunic of plain undyed grey hemp, clean, a crossed collar, short sleeves, a rope belt; no cord or star; the cuffs and fingertips are stained blue-black with ink. Hands and objects: a long feather duster in the right hand; the left carrying a flat grey grinding stone with a small cake of black ink and a damp rag; a stool with a bucket. Background: blurred tall shelves of identical lacquered boxes. Rows of lacquered boxes climb into shadow and a single lamp throws warm light on their curved edges. Light: soft warm lamplight from the upper left and dust motes; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a shy, timid, blue-lipped smile with round eyes cast sideways, an anxious boy hoping he is dusting the right shelf.

people.imagined: In the little cord room she ties the seventh knot in a black cord with perfectly practised fingers, and smiles the half-smile of someone who already knows who passed. She does not look at the viewer; she looks at the cord.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a small table she draws the seventh knot tight on a black cord, her eyes on her fingers and a knowing half-smile playing at her mouth. Face: a smooth, round, serene face; downcast dark eyes with a glint beneath the lids; neat thin brows; a small nose; a closed half-smile with one corner lifted, the look of a person who knows. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a felt-white scrap of cloth tied round it. Body: small, sturdy, composed. Clothing: a servant's tunic of plain undyed grey hemp with a crossed collar, sleeves tied back; felt fuzz clinging to the cuffs; no cord or star herself. Hands and objects (the fingertips must read): the fingertips of both hands are hardened into glossy yellow calluses, shown clearly as she draws the knot; a dark black cord with six tight knots and the seventh forming; on the table a row of identical black cords, coiled, in a neat line, and a small bowl of wax. Background: blurred small room with shelves of folded grey robes and a narrow window. Light: soft daylight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: diligent, temperate, deceitful; always a day ahead of the list.

people.imagined: On the Thạch Kiều road, bowed forward under a tall stack of lacquered case boxes, the strap across his forehead. He walks as he has walked for years, calm, content, and nobody else is trusted with the sealed ones.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a road bent permanently forward under a huge stack of lacquered case boxes lashed to a wooden frame on his back, a broad strap across his forehead, his eyes lifted to meet the viewer's. Face (most important: the forehead groove): a broad, plain, calm, tanned face; a deep dented groove across the forehead, red and polished, where the tump-line rides, clearly visible; mild dark eyes; thick brows; a flat nose; a placid closed mouth. Hair: black, cropped short and sweaty, under a small straw cap pushed back. Body: stocky, immensely strong in the neck and legs, the back bowed in a permanent bow even when empty. Clothing: a plain undyed grey hemp tunic with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled and tied, short trousers wrapped at the calves; no cord or star; rope sandals. Hands and objects: both hands gripping the straps at his chest; on his back a tall frame stacked with a dozen identical dark lacquered boxes, the top few bound with red cord and plain blank wax seals. Background: blurred stone road and pines in mild haze. Light: soft afternoon light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: calm, loyal, content; trusted with the sealed ones.

people.imagined: Sweeping the Bridge Court steps in the cold morning with a broom taller than she is, bare, chapped ankles in the frost, chattering to the regulars on the steps by name. She is also counting who came.
people.subject: The moment: sweeping long stone steps with a broom much taller than herself, she pauses and looks up with a bright, brisk, knowing smile at the viewer, as at a regular. Face: a small, sharp, pretty, street-bred face; lively dark eyes with a calculating sparkle; thin arched brows; a small upturned nose; a ready, cheerful, empty smile; chapped red cheeks. Hair: black, in two short tight braids with red wool, a few strands loose. Body: small, thin, quick, standing straight like a young soldier. Clothing: a plain undyed grey hemp tunic with a crossed collar and short sleeves, belted with a rope, clean and mended; no cord or star; a short shawl of grey felt; bare ankles above old cloth shoes, the ankles red and chapped, plainly visible. Hands and objects: a very tall birch-twig broom held in both hands, its top above her head; on the steps behind her a scattering of small figures sitting listening, a few leaves and a bit of straw. Background: blurred wide stone steps of the Bridge Court with pillars and a crowd of onlookers in winter coats. Light: cold bright morning light from the upper left; a faint warm fire qi hint. Expression: gregarious, callous, fickle; all smiles, counting heads.

people.imagined: In the crane loft at the seat he is whistling softly through his teeth and checking a tall crane's wing, a feather tucked in his collar. He knows each bird by a single feather.
people.subject: The moment: in a loft he runs a gentle hand along the long folded wing of a tall white crane while whistling softly through his teeth, looking up with a mild smile. Face: a gentle, plain, sunburnt face; mild brown eyes; soft thin brows; a straight nose; lips pursed round a quiet whistle; a gap in the front teeth. Hair: black, in a loose knot, a long white crane feather tucked in his collar and another behind his ear. Body: lanky, slow, quiet, a patient stoop. Clothing: a plain undyed grey hemp tunic with a crossed collar and short sleeves, sleeves dusty with feather down; no cord or star; a broad leather belt with a pouch of grain; a pair of leather gauntlets tucked in. Hands and objects: the right hand smoothing the crane's wing; the left holding a small bucket of fish scraps; the tall white crane with black wingtips and a red crown standing beside him with its long neck curved toward his shoulder; a small pale feather in his palm. Background: blurred wooden crane loft with perches, hanging nets and a wide window of sky. Light: soft bright light from the upper left; a faint green wood qi hint. Expression: peaceable, patient, humble; knows his birds.

people.imagined: Late at night in the head's court, he has set down his go stone and looks up at the viewer; the stone seal rests at his chest on its cord. He looks fifty and slightly tired, and the inked middle finger of his right hand has just smoothed a page.
people.subject: The moment: at a go board late at night he lifts his eyes from a stone held between two fingers to look steadily at the viewer, the grey seal swinging on its cord at his chest. Face: a narrow, quiet, slightly tired, clever face; fine lines at the eyes; calm, grey, accountant's eyes with a hint of shadow beneath; thin level brows; a straight narrow nose; a thin, closed, patient mouth; a short, neat grey beard along the jaw. Hair: dark grey, combed back and gathered in a plain flat knot with a dark iron pin. Body: slim, narrow, straight-backed, seated with perfect economy. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, immaculate and plain, a crossed collar edged with a faint darker grey band, wide sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: the right middle finger is stained black with ink to the first joint, held out clearly as it grips a white go stone; a palm-sized square grey stone seal on a cord at his chest, cut with a pole and seven small dots (no writing); a go board with scattered black and white stones. Background: blurred dim head's court, a lamp and plain grey hangings. Light: warm low lamplight from the lower left; a faint ochre earth qi hint and a steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: arbitrary, cautious, calm; a head who thinks by the slow clock.

people.imagined: In the first elder's seat, dusk, huge and slow; a spear leans like a staff against his knee and a grey pebble turns in his thumb. He plays go with his disciple on the first night of the year and is waiting for a banner.
people.subject: The moment: seated, massive and slow, he looks up at the viewer with a heavy lidded gaze while his right thumb turns a small grey pebble over and over. Face (most important: the scar): a huge, heavy, craggy face with a long jagged seam of grey-white scar running from the left collarbone up the side of the neck to the ear, clearly visible against bronzed skin; small, patient, deep-set black eyes under heavy white brows; a broad, flat, broken nose; a thick, down-turned mouth; a short thick white beard. Hair: thick white hair, cropped, brushed back. Body: enormous, slow, a miner's huge shoulders and bull neck, a great chest, seated like a boulder.
