Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, ample, with a crossed collar, over a dull grey scale coat of dark iron scales showing at the shoulders; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a long spear with a dark iron head leaning upright against his knee like a walking staff, the shaft worn smooth; a grey pebble worn smooth between thumb and finger. Background: blurred dim stone hall with a high window and a faint far star. Light: low amber light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint with a heavy ochre cast. Expression: patient, vengeful, faithless; a slow giant waiting.

people.imagined: At the Bridge Court bench, she has begun to speak and speaks so quietly that the court itself carries her voice. Her fist closes on the black Weight. Her unfinished judgement lies before her.
people.subject: The moment: seated on the bench in the Bridge Court she speaks in a quiet voice, lips barely moving, one small hand closed around a black fist-sized stone on the bench before her. Face: a small, square-jawed, composed face; steady dark eyes that read like a balance beam; level straight brows; a short straight nose; a narrow, firm, quiet mouth; a few fine lines. Hair: black with a streak of grey, in a smooth low knot pinned with a plain iron pin. Body: small, square-shouldered, upright and still, a judge's absolute stillness. Clothing: the grey bench robe, plain and unembroidered, with seven arches woven in the same grey at the hem, a crossed collar; the cuffs are darker where hands have rested; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. At her chest a pale grey stone pendant, cold-looking. Hands and objects: the right hand closed on a black stone the size of a fist, the Weight, resting on a small wooden stand; a rolled, unsealed scroll tied with grey cord laid beside it (blank). Background: blurred high stone court with pillars and rows of silent listeners on steps beyond an arch. Light: cool even light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: just, stubborn, reclusive; a quiet that carries.

people.imagined: At the edge of the war-writ office he stands at the margin of the room as he always does, hands behind his back, looking at the iron-hooped drum that hangs behind his chair and thinking of the marshal's banner.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a room, he looks past the viewer toward a big iron-hooped drum hanging on the wall, jaw set. Face: a square, hard, sunburnt face with a heavy jaw; keen pale-brown hawk's eyes under thick straight brows; a strong, sharp, slightly hooked nose; a firm, honest, thin mouth; sun-lines at the eyes; stubble of white. Hair: grey, cropped short like a brush, standing straight. Body: broad, square, tall, a soldier's weight and stillness, standing to one side and a little forward as a man who stays near the door. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, plain and clean, with a crossed collar and tight sleeves, over a dark grey leather harness; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands clasped behind his back; propped near him a plain spear with seven notches cut in the shaft; on the wall behind, a big drum hooped with black iron and skinned with ox hide; a furled black flag with white studs on a stand. Background: blurred war-office wall with maps (plain coloured shapes) and a rack of spears. Light: hard daylight from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: warlike, ambitious, honest; waiting for his war.

people.imagined: In a courteous audience he smiles a dry, handsome smile, white jade tally hung at his hip where a sword would be and an iron fan folded harmless in his hand. He is thinking of a peace that will end the counting.
people.subject: The moment: in a courteous audience he inclines his head with a dry, polished, handsome smile and taps a closed iron fan lightly against his palm. Face: a long-faced, handsome, dry man; fine regular features; bright, shrewd dark eyes; level, arched brows; a long, straight nose; a thin, elegant, slightly superior mouth; a neat black pointed beard. Hair: black, glossy, in a high knot with a fine iron pin and a single jade bead. Body: tall, slim, easy, a diplomat's relaxed upright carriage. Clothing: a robe of grey court silk a shade finer than the seat allows, with a faint sheen and a crossed collar, wide sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: at the hip, where a sword would hang, a white jade half-tally on a grey cord, plainly visible; a closed iron fan with dull steel ribs in his right hand; a small pale-green teacup in the left. Background: blurred courteous reception hall with a screen and a window of pale light. Light: warm light from the upper left, a gleam on the jade; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: deceitful, pragmatic, arrogant; politeness with a blade in it.

people.imagined: In the archive, frail and bent, with black ink to the wrists and her hand on the keys on their cord around her neck. She touches them when she speaks, and is thinking of a missing half of a tally.
people.subject: The moment: standing bent over a cane among tall archive shelves, an extremely old woman raises a hand to touch the keys at her throat while looking sharply at the viewer. Face: a very old, very thin, deeply wrinkled face like folded paper; clever, sharp, black eyes bright in hollows; thin white brows; a sharp small nose; thin pale lips pressed; hollow cheeks. Her skin is spotted with age and almost translucent at the temples. Hair: sparse snow-white hair gathered in a very small tight bun with a single iron pin. Body: tiny, bent nearly double, frail, thin as a bird, leaning on a stick. Clothing: a dust-grey robe, reinforced at the elbows with neat panels of matching grey cloth, since she is always leaning on shelves, a crossed collar, long wide sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the black wrists must read): both hands and wrists are black with ink to the wrist, as if gloved in black, plainly visible; at her neck on a cord a bronze key on a jade bead, touched by two black fingers; a cane of dark wood. Background: blurred towering archive shelves of lacquered boxes. A single lamp hangs from a hook and long ladders lean against the shelves. Light: low warm lamplight from the upper left, dust motes; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a sharp, guarded, unwavering stare with the thin lips pressed, a frail old woman who guards every shelf and counts every key.

people.imagined: Steward of the seat, walking the long corridor with a rolling gait as if on a deck, ledger strings at his sleeve, a straight blade hanging point-down at his back. He has wanted the Seal for a century and has stopped being ashamed.
people.subject: The moment: striding along a corridor with a slight rolling sailor's gait, he turns his broad head to the viewer with a steady, assessing look. Face: a broad, weathered, strong face tanned by harbour winds; narrow keen grey eyes under heavy straight brows; a wide, flat-bridged nose; a firm, wide, thin-lipped mouth; short clipped iron-grey stubble and a short grey beard. Hair: iron grey, tied in a plain knot with an iron pin. Body: broad, thick-shouldered, heavy and well balanced, walking with weight low like a man on a rolling deck. Clothing: a plain, immaculate, fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar, wide sleeves; ledger strings, thin grey cords with tiny wooden tally beads, hanging at the right sleeve; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: on his back, hanging point-down from a strap, a narrow perfectly straight sword like a plumb line, its pommel showing over the shoulder; at the belt a small jade-cased level; the right hand carrying a bound ledger (plain cover). Background: blurred long stone corridor with pillars and a distant lamp. Light: cool light from the upper left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: ambitious, diligent, callous; a steward who wants the chair.

people.imagined: First on the training floor at dawn and the last to leave; she has caught the first sunlight on her short gold-tinted sword and is looking back at the viewer, quick and sure, her hair tied up with a gold cord.
people.subject: The moment: on a training floor at first light she stands in a fresh sword stance, a short gold-tinted blade raised catching the sun, glancing quickly at the viewer. Face: a tall, strong, quick, sun-browned woman's face; bright, bold, dark brown eyes; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a firm, confident, slightly smiling mouth; a fine sheen of sweat. Hair: black, tied up high in a tail bound with a thin gold cord, a few strands stuck to her temples. Body: tall, long-limbed, athletic, quick in the stance, shoulders squared. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe, close-fitting with tight sleeves bound at the wrist for movement, crossed collar; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small gold-thread edge at the collar; a short grey wrap at the waist. Hands and objects: a short, gold-tinted flying sword with a plain grip held in her right hand, the blade catching the dawn; in the left hand, a small plain flag of pale cloth on a short staff (no marks) planted behind her second; the ink stain on her middle finger. Background: blurred wide stone training floor, pale dawn sky, a few figures at the far end. Light: warm gold first light from the upper left catching the blade; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: ambitious, brave, diligent; first on the floor.

people.imagined: Across a table she is reading the other person's handwriting upside down, thin and freckled, soot-grey at the fingertips. She has the face of someone who has given a document away and cannot take it back.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a table she leans forward and reads, upside down, a document placed before the viewer, her head tilted, eyes sharp and level. Face: a thin, freckled, honest face; clear grey-green eyes quick and attentive; straight thin brows; a narrow nose crowded with freckles; a firm thin mouth; a faint line of worry between the brows. Hair: reddish-brown, in a simple low plait pinned up, a few strands loose. Body: thin, narrow, shoulders drawn in, leaning over the table. Clothing: a fine undyed grey robe with a crossed collar and long sleeves stained with ink and a faint soot-grey tint at the cuffs; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; no star. Hands and objects (the fingertips must read): the fingertips of both hands are soot-grey, a dull charcoal colour; a small round soapstone seal with a plain carved pattern (no letters) in the right hand; before her a sheet of paper with only faint ruled lines, seen upside down; a brush laid across an ink slab. Background: blurred archive copying room, shelves of lacquered boxes. Light: soft grey light from the upper left and a warm lamp; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: honest, just, brave; a copyist who has handed on something dangerous.

people.imagined: The founder at eighty arriving on the Thiên Tuyền plateau under the Dipper, laughing, a drinking gourd in his hand, a hermit's foundling who won mountains by fair weights. He has just sat to drink with an old friend.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a mountain rock beneath a night sky he laughs heartily with a drinking gourd raised, the picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad, open, weathered face lined with laughter; a long thick white beard to the chest; bright, merry, dark eyes crinkled with laughter; thick white brows; a big nose; a wide open mouth, white teeth. Deep laugh lines run from his eyes to his temples. Hair: long white hair, loose and wild, bound with a plain cord at the brow. Body: tall, broad, lean, a hardy hermit's build, one knee up. Clothing: a long plain undyed robe of rough hemp, neatly mended and clean, a crossed collar, wide sleeves; a rope belt hung with a small bronze balance; no ornament. Hands and objects: a big round drinking gourd raised in the right hand; in the left a small round grey weight stone; a staff beside him; seven faint stars in a Dipper shape above his head in the dark sky. Background: faded dark blue-black night, a ridge, and the seven stars. A tiny red fire flickers at the foot of the rock and throws a faint glow on the gourd. Light: low pale starlight from the upper left with a faint warm firelight below. Expression: a big, open, merry laugh with crinkled eyes and white teeth, the easy warmth of a founder drinking with old friends under the stars.

people.imagined: The war marshal on the ramparts of Cố Lũy, the star-iron halberd planted beside him, a goatherd's son who has become the rampart. He looks out calmly at the army below, bright with loyalty.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a rampart in full armour he plants a long halberd beside him and looks out over the viewer's shoulder with calm, burning loyalty, the picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad, rugged, honest face; a black beard cropped square; steady dark eyes under heavy straight brows; a broken nose; a firm mouth. Hair: black, in a tight topknot under a plain iron helmet pushed back. A few grey threads run through the black at his temples and the helmet's cheek-strap is knotted under his jaw. Body: huge, broad-shouldered, thick-armed, a goatherd's strength grown into a marshal's. Clothing: dark star-iron lamellar armour with grey cord lacing over a plain grey robe with a crossed collar; a heavy grey wool cloak thrown back; a broad belt. Hands and objects: a long halberd with a crescent blade of dark star iron, haft taller than he is, planted at his side with the right hand; the left on the rampart wall. Background: faded dusky ramparts with banners (plain dark cloth) and an army as small dark shapes below. Above the wall a plain pole bears a limp dark banner, and the sky behind the rampart is low and pale. Light: low pale light from the upper left. Expression: brave, loyal, wrathful; the rampart itself.

people.imagined: In the cave abode on the plain, after 147 years of hiding, he sits at the cave mouth with a furled banner across his knees, an old wound making him stiff. He does not move.
people.subject: The moment: in the dim mouth of a cave an old soldier sits with a rolled banner across his knees, staring out stonily; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a gaunt, weathered, grim face; a long unkempt grey beard; deep-set, honest, dark eyes under heavy grey brows; a long nose; a hard, closed mouth; a pale scar down one cheek. His brows are thick and white at the ends, and his hands show blue veins. Hair: long grey hair, tied back with a strip of cloth. Body: lean, stiff, hard, sitting with one leg stretched out straight from an old wound. Clothing: a long, worn, dark grey officer's coat with a high collar, mended with meticulous stitches and clean; a rope belt; battered iron shoulder plates. Hands and objects: a rolled dark banner, tightly furled, with only a black shape visible, across his knees, both hands gripping it; a broken sabre hilt leaning against the rock; a small oil lamp at his foot. Background: faded dark cave mouth with a pale slice of grassy plain beyond. Light: dim grey daylight from the upper left and a small yellow lamp glow. The faded silk tone turns everything to sepia, grey-green and muted rust. Expression: a stony, steady, silent endurance, the dark eyes unmoving and the mouth shut, an old soldier keeping faith with a lost cause.

people.imagined: The first Chief Judge, a scribe's daughter, seated at a plain desk with the freshly ground ink beside her and the first Weight in her hand, calm and humble, writing the wording of the Compact.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a plain desk she lifts a long brush and a black stone weight, glancing up with a calm, humble, attentive look; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a kind, composed, lined face; clear, quiet, dark eyes; level thin brows; a small straight nose; a gentle, firm mouth; a high smooth forehead. Faint ink smudges mark her right cheek where a hand has passed, and a tiny mole sits near the corner of her mouth. Hair: black with grey, in a smooth low coil pinned with two plain wooden pins. Body: small, upright, still, a scholar's straight back. Clothing: a plain robe of undyed grey with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, long and unadorned, an early form of the Bridge Court robe with a plain hem; a simple cord belt. Hands and objects: a long brush in the right hand and a small fist-sized black stone weight in the left; a stone ink-slab worn into a hollow with fresh black ink; a long blank scroll unrolled across the desk. Background: faded pale wall and a window with a pale sky. Light: soft low light from the upper left. Expression: just, patient, humble; ready to set down the first words. A grave, kind calm, as of someone about to write down a rule that will outlive her.

people.imagined: On the fort's stair at Phá Quân Môn, envoy's staff in his hand, he has delivered a refusal and is turning to go down; he is peaceable, brave, and does not know what the next step will cost. A poet by habit, he notices the light on the stone.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a high stone stair with an envoy's staff held upright, he has just turned to descend and looks back over his shoulder at the viewer with a quiet, steady, slightly sad smile; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a lean, gentle, scholarly face; kind, clear, dark eyes with a hint of poetry in them; level thin brows; a straight nose; a calm, closed, peaceable mouth; a thin neat grey-black beard and moustache. Hair: black going grey, in a neat knot with a plain pin. Body: slim, upright, tall, a diplomat's composed posture, unarmed, hands open. Clothing: a fine undyed grey travelling robe, clean, with a crossed collar and wide sleeves; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a small silver star at the collar; no sword and no iron anywhere on him. Hands and objects: a tall, plain envoy's wooden staff, topped with a plain wooden knob, held upright in the right hand; the left hand open, empty, palm out; a rolled letter (blank) tied with grey cord tucked in his sleeve. Background: faded pale stone stair rising to a fort gate, a pale sky and a few distant dark shapes. Light: soft low pale light from the upper left. Expression: brave, honest, peaceable; a man who carried a refusal without a weapon.

people.imagined: On the north rampart of Cố Lũy after five years of holding it, he stands steadfast beside his father's army, his small daughter far behind in a signal post. He is stubborn and loyal and turns to look back once.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a rampart in armour with his hand on a spear, he looks back toward the viewer with a stubborn, loyal, tired look; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad, rugged, strong face like his father's; a black beard clipped short; steady dark eyes under heavy straight brows; a broken nose; a firm, tight mouth; a pale scar crossing the left cheek. Deep lines mark his brow and the corners of his mouth. Hair: black, tied in a topknot under a plain iron helmet. Body: huge, broad, thick-armed, sturdy as the wall. Clothing: dark iron lamellar armour with grey cord lacing over a plain grey robe with a crossed collar; a black cord with seven knots at the waist; a heavy grey wool cloak. Hands and objects: a long spear with a dark iron head in the right hand, the butt on the stones; the left hand resting on a notched sabre hilt; a small carved wooden toy bird on a cord at his belt. Background: faded dusky ramparts of a high fort and a pale sky with a dark banner. Light: low pale light from the upper left. The faded silk tone turns the whole scene to dusty rose, slate and ochre. Expression: a stubborn, tired, loyal look back over the shoulder with the jaw set, a man who holds the wall and thinks once of his daughter.
